units.zh: 張勛，字少軒，江西奉新人。
units.en: Zhang Xun, whose style name was Shaoxuan, came from Fengxin in Jiangxi.
units.literal: Zhang Xun, style name Shaoxuan, was a native of Fengxin in Jiangxi.

units.zh: 少孤貧。
units.en: He lost his parents early and grew up in poverty.
units.literal: In youth he was orphaned and poor.

units.zh: 投效廣西軍，預法越之戰，累保至參將。
units.en: He joined the Guangxi forces, fought in the Sino-French War, and was repeatedly promoted until he reached the rank of colonel.
units.literal: He enlisted in the Guangxi army, took part in the Sino-French War, and through repeated commendations rose to the rank of colonel.

units.zh: 日韓釁啟，隨毅軍防守奉天。
units.en: When the conflict between Japan and Korea erupted, he served with the Yiji Army in the defense of Fengtian.
units.literal: When trouble broke out between Japan and Korea, he followed the Yiji Army to defend Fengtian.

units.zh: 袁世凱練兵小站，充管帶。
units.en: When Yuan Shikai raised his new army at Xiaozhan, Zhang served as a battalion commander.
units.literal: When Yuan Shikai trained troops at Xiaozhan, he served as a battalion commander.

units.zh: 拳匪亂作，統巡防營防剿，敘功擢副將，賞壯勇巴圖魯。
units.en: During the Boxer rebellion he led defensive battalions in pacification campaigns and, his achievements recorded, was promoted to vice general and granted the title Valiant Batulu.
units.literal: When the Boxer uprising broke out, he commanded garrison defense battalions in suppression operations; for his merit he was promoted to vice general and awarded the title Valiant Batulu.

units.zh: 兩宮回鑾，隨扈至京，諭留宿衛，授建昌鎮總兵，擢雲南提督，改甘肅，皆不赴。
units.en: When the court returned to Beijing, Zhang escorted the imperial party and was told to remain on palace guard duty. He was named commander at Jianchang, then offered the posts of military governor of Yunnan and Gansu in turn, but he declined them all.
units.literal: When the two palaces returned to the capital, he escorted them to Beijing; he was ordered to remain on palace guard duty, appointed commander at Jianchang, promoted to Yunnan provincial military governor, then reassigned to Gansu—he accepted none of these posts.

units.zh: 日俄戰後，調奉天，充行營翼長，節制三省防軍，賞黃馬褂。
units.en: After the Russo-Japanese War he was posted to Fengtian as deputy chief of the field headquarters with authority over the defense forces of three provinces, and was granted a yellow riding jacket.
units.literal: After the Russo-Japanese War he was transferred to Fengtian, served as deputy chief of the field headquarters, controlled the defense forces of three provinces, and was awarded a yellow jacket.

units.zh: 旋命總統江防各軍，駐浦口，調江南提督。
units.en: He was soon placed in command of all Yangtze river defense forces, headquartered at Pukou, and appointed military governor of Jiangnan.
units.literal: Soon afterward he was ordered to command all Yangtze defense forces, stationed at Pukou, and transferred to Jiangnan military governor.

units.zh: 武昌變起，蘇州獨立，總督張人駿、將軍鐵良方與眾籌戰守，有持異議者，勳直斥之。
units.en: After the Wuchang uprising Suzhou seceded. Governor Zhang Renjun and General Tie Liang met with their officials to debate whether to fight or hold out, and Zhang Xun sharply denounced anyone who dissented.
units.literal: When the Wuchang revolt erupted and Suzhou declared independence, Governor Zhang Renjun and General Tie Liang discussed war and defense with the assembly; when someone disagreed, Zhang Xun rebuked him outright.

units.zh: 翌日，新軍變，勳與戰於雨花台，大破之。
units.en: The following day the New Army mutinied; Zhang fought them at Yuhuatai and inflicted a crushing defeat.
units.literal: The next day the New Army mutinied; Zhang Xun fought them at Yuhuatai and routed them.

units.zh: 江、浙軍合來攻，糧援胥絕，乃轉戰，退而屯徐州，完所部。
units.en: When combined Jiangsu and Zhejiang armies advanced against him and supplies and reinforcements were cut off entirely, he fought a running campaign, fell back to hold Xuzhou, and kept his forces largely intact.
units.literal: Jiangsu and Zhejiang forces came to attack together; grain and reinforcements were wholly cut off; he therefore fought on the move, withdrew to garrison at Xuzhou, and preserved his command intact.

units.zh: 人駿、鐵良走上海。
units.en: Zhang Renjun and Tie Liang withdrew to Shanghai.
units.literal: Zhang Renjun and Tie Liang fled to Shanghai.

units.zh: 命勳為江蘇巡撫，攝兩江總督，賞輕車都尉。
units.en: Zhang Xun was named governor of Jiangsu and acting governor-general of Liangjiang, and granted the title Commandery Marquis of Chariots.
units.literal: Zhang Xun was appointed Jiangsu governor, acting as Liangjiang governor-general, and awarded the title of Commandery Marquis of Chariots.

units.zh: 遜位詔下，世凱遣使勞問，勳答曰：「袁公之知不可負，君臣之義不能忘。
units.en: After the abdication edict was promulgated, Yuan Shikai sent emissaries with congratulations. Zhang replied, "I cannot betray Lord Yuan's kindness, nor forget the obligations between sovereign and subject.
units.literal: When the abdication edict was issued, Yuan Shikai sent envoys to offer congratulations; Zhang Xun replied: "Lord Yuan's favor must not be betrayed; the duty between ruler and subject cannot be forgotten.

units.zh: 袁公不負朝廷，勳安敢負袁公？」
units.en: If Lord Yuan has not failed the dynasty, how dare I fail Lord Yuan?"
units.literal: If Lord Yuan does not fail the court, how dare Zhang Xun fail Lord Yuan?"

units.zh: 世凱歷假勳定武上將軍、江北鎮撫使、長江巡閱使、江蘇都督、安徽督軍。
units.en: Yuan successively conferred on him acting titles as Generalissimo of Dingwu, pacification commissioner for Jiangbei, Yangtze patrol commissioner, military governor of Jiangsu, and commander of Anhui.
units.literal: Yuan Shikai repeatedly lent Zhang Xun the titles of Generalissimo of Dingwu, Pacification Commissioner of Jiangbei, Yangtze Patrol Commissioner, Military Governor of Jiangsu, and Military Commander of Anhui.

units.zh: 及建號，勳首起抗阻，並請優待皇室，保衛宮廷。
units.en: When Yuan took an imperial title, Zhang was the first to resist, while calling for the royal house to be treated leniently and the palace to be safeguarded.
units.literal: When Yuan proclaimed himself emperor, Zhang Xun was the first to stand in opposition, and he also petitioned for generous treatment of the imperial house and protection of the palace.

units.zh: 世凱卒，各省有所謀，群集徐州，推勳主盟。
units.en: After Yuan's death, as provincial leaders began scheming in various directions, they assembled at Xuzhou and made Zhang Xun their chief.
units.literal: After Yuan Shikai died, when the provinces were plotting various schemes, they gathered at Xuzhou and chose Zhang Xun to lead the alliance.

units.zh: 勳於是提兵北上，叩謁宮門，遂復闢。
units.en: Zhang then marched north with his troops, paid homage at the palace gates, and effected the restoration of the monarchy.
units.literal: Zhang Xun thereupon led his army north, knelt at the palace gate seeking audience, and thus restored the throne.

units.zh: 連下詔令，首頒复政諭云：「朕不幸以沖齡繼承大業，煢煢在疚，未堪多難。
units.en: A series of edicts followed, opening with a proclamation on the restoration of rule: "Having inherited the vast inheritance in my minority, I stand solitary and stricken, scarcely fit to weather further disasters.
units.literal: Edicts were issued in succession; the first was the restoration proclamation, which read: "We unfortunately inherited the great enterprise in tender years, alone and burdened with cares, unable to bear many calamities.

units.zh: 辛亥變起，我孝定景皇后至德深仁，不忍生民塗炭，毅然以祖宗創垂之重，億兆生靈之命，付託前閣臣袁世凱，設臨時政府，推讓政權，公諸天下，冀以息爭弭亂，民得安居。
units.en: When the Xinhai revolution broke out, Empress Dowager Xiaoding, in her deep virtue and compassion, could not bear to see the people brought to ruin. She resolutely entrusted the ancestral enterprise and the fate of the multitudes to the former grand councillor Yuan Shikai, set up a provisional government, and yielded power to the nation, hoping to still contention and restore peace so the people could live securely.
units.literal: The Xinhai uprising arose; Our Empress Dowager Xiaoding, of surpassing virtue and profound benevolence, could not bear to see the people suffer ravage; she resolutely entrusted the heavy legacy left by our ancestors and the lives of hundreds of millions to the former Grand Councillor Yuan Shikai, established a provisional government, and yielded political power to the world, hoping thereby to quell strife and end chaos so the people might live in peace.

units.zh: 乃國體自改共和以來，紛爭無已，迭起干戈，強劫暴斂，賄賂公行，歲入增至四萬萬而仍患不足，外債增出十餘萬萬而有加無已。
units.en: Yet since the nation adopted republican government, conflict has never ceased, wars have broken out again and again, armed robbery and violent exactions have spread, bribery runs unchecked, annual revenue has climbed to four hundred million yuan yet still falls short, and foreign debt has swollen by more than a billion with no limit in sight.
units.literal: Yet since the state changed to a republic, strife has been unceasing, wars have arisen in succession, armed robbery and violent exactions prevail, bribery is openly practiced, annual revenue has risen to four hundred million yet still proves insufficient, and foreign debt has increased by more than a billion with no end in sight.

units.zh: 海內囂然，喪其樂生之氣，使我孝定景皇后不得已遜政恤民之舉，轉以重苦吾民。
units.en: The realm has grown turbulent, and the people's will to live in peace has been broken; the very act by which Empress Dowager Xiaoding reluctantly abdicated to spare the people has instead deepened their affliction.
units.literal: Within the seas all is clamorous; the people's will to live in peace is lost; the act by which Our Empress Dowager Xiaoding reluctantly yielded rule to spare the people has instead redoubled their suffering.

units.zh: 此誠我孝定景皇后初衷所不及料，在天之靈，惻痛難安；
units.en: This was truly beyond what Empress Dowager Xiaoding could have foreseen in her original intent; her spirit in Heaven must ache with unbearable sorrow;
units.literal: This was truly beyond what Our Empress Dowager Xiaoding's original intent could foresee; her spirit in Heaven must ache with unbearable sorrow;

units.zh: 而朕深居宮禁，日夜禱天，徬徨飲泣，不知所出者也。
units.en: while I, deep within the palace confines, pray to Heaven day and night, wander in distress and weep, and know not what course to take.
units.literal: while We, deep within the palace confines, pray to Heaven day and night, wander in distress and weep, and know not what course to take.

units.zh: 今者復以黨爭激成兵禍，天下洶洶，久莫能定，共和解體，補救已窮。
units.en: Now party strife has again ignited military disaster; the realm has been in turmoil for so long that order cannot be restored; the republic has disintegrated, and every remedy has been exhausted.
units.literal: Now party strife has again stirred up military disaster; the realm is in turmoil and long unable to settle; the republic has disintegrated and remedies are exhausted.

units.zh: 據張勛等以『國本動搖，人心思舊，合詞奏請復闢，以拯生靈』，各等語。
units.en: According to Zhang Xun and others, who jointly memorialized that "the foundation of the state is shaken, the people's hearts yearn for the old order, and we beg restoration of the throne to save the people," and similar statements.
units.literal: According to Zhang Xun and others, who jointly memorialized that "the foundation of the state is shaken, the people's hearts yearn for the old order, and we beg restoration of the throne to save the living," and similar words.

units.zh: 覽奏，情詞懇切，實深痛懼。
units.en: On reading the memorial, I found its language earnest and was deeply pained and fearful.
units.literal: On reading the memorial, its language is earnest and We are deeply pained and fearful.

units.zh: 既不敢以天下存亡之大責，遂輕任於眇躬；
units.en: I dare not lightly take upon my slight person the great responsibility for the survival of the realm;
units.literal: We dare not lightly take upon Our slight person the great responsibility for the survival of the realm;

units.zh: 又不忍以一姓禍福之讏言，置兆民於不顧。
units.en: yet I cannot bear, on account of words concerning the fortune of one house, to abandon the millions of the people.
units.literal: yet We cannot bear, on account of words concerning the fortune of one surname, to abandon the millions of the people.

units.zh: 權衡重輕，天人交迫，不得已允如所奏，於宣統九年1917年五月十三日臨朝聽政，收回大權，與民更始。
units.en: Weighing what matters most, pressed by Heaven and men alike, I have no choice but to grant the request as memorialized; on the thirteenth day of the fifth month in the ninth year of Xuantong (1917) I shall attend court and resume rule, reclaim supreme authority, and make a new beginning with the people.
units.literal: Weighing what is heavy and light, pressed by Heaven and men alike, We have no choice but to grant the request as memorialized; on the thirteenth day of the fifth month in the ninth year of Xuantong (1917) We shall attend court and resume rule, reclaim great authority, and make a new beginning with the people.

units.zh: 自今以往，以綱常名教為精神之憲法，以禮義廉恥收潰決之人心。
units.en: From this time forward, let the bonds of human relations and moral teaching serve as the spiritual constitution, and let propriety, righteousness, integrity, and shame gather up the dissolving hearts of the people.
units.literal: From this time forward, let the bonds of human relations and moral teaching serve as the spiritual constitution, and let propriety, righteousness, integrity, and shame gather up the dissolving hearts of the people.

units.zh: 上下以至誠相感，不徒恃法守為維繫之資；
units.en: Above and below shall be moved by utmost sincerity toward one another, and shall not rely solely on observance of law as the means of cohesion;
units.literal: Above and below shall be moved by utmost sincerity toward one another, and shall not rely solely on observance of law as the means of cohesion;

units.zh: 政令以懲毖為心，不得以國本為嘗試之具。
units.en: government orders shall take correction and discipline as their aim, and the foundation of the state must not be treated as an instrument for experiment.
units.literal: government orders shall take correction and discipline as their aim, and the foundation of the state must not be treated as an instrument for experiment.

units.zh: 況當此萬象虛耗，元氣垂竭，存亡絕續之交，朕臨深履薄，固不敢有樂為君，稍有縱逸。
units.en: Moreover, at this moment when all things are drained hollow and vital force is near exhaustion, at the juncture between survival and extinction, I stand over the abyss and tread on thin ice; I truly dare not take pleasure in being ruler or indulge in the slightest laxity.
units.literal: Moreover, at this moment when all things are drained hollow and vital force is near exhaustion, at the juncture between survival and extinction, We stand over the abyss and tread on thin ice; We truly dare not take pleasure in being ruler or indulge in the slightest laxity.

units.zh: 爾大小臣工，尤當精白乃心，滌除舊染，息息以民瘼為念。
units.en: You ministers great and small must especially purify your hearts, wash away old stains, and at every breath keep the people's afflictions in mind.
units.literal: You ministers great and small must especially purify your hearts, wash away old stains, and at every breath keep the people's afflictions in mind.

units.zh: 為民生留一分元氣，即為國家延一息命脈，庶幾危亡可救，感召天庥。
units.en: To preserve for the people's livelihood one portion of vital force is to extend for the state one breath of its life-thread; then perhaps ruin may be averted and Heaven's blessing be drawn down.
units.literal: To preserve for the people's livelihood one portion of vital force is to extend for the state one breath of its life-thread; then perhaps ruin may be saved and Heaven's blessing be drawn down.

units.zh: 所有興復初政亟應興革諸大端，條舉如下：*欽遵德宗景皇帝諭旨，大權統於朝廷，庶政公諸輿論，定為大清帝國君主立憲政體。
units.en: All major points urgently to be enacted or reformed at the beginning of restored rule are listed as follows: In reverent obedience to the edict of Emperor Guangxu, supreme authority shall be unified in the court and ordinary administration referred to public opinion; the form of government is fixed as a constitutional monarchy of the Great Qing Empire.
units.literal: All major points urgently to be enacted or reformed at the beginning of restored rule are listed as follows: * In reverent obedience to the edict of Emperor Dezong Jing, supreme authority shall be unified in the court and ordinary administration referred to public opinion; the form of government is fixed as a constitutional monarchy of the Great Qing Empire.

units.zh: *皇室經費，仍照所定每年四百萬元數目，按年撥用，不得絲毫增加。
units.en: Imperial household expenses shall still follow the fixed annual sum of four million yuan, disbursed year by year, and must not be increased in the slightest.
units.literal: * Imperial household expenses shall still follow the fixed annual sum of four million yuan, disbursed year by year, and must not be increased in the slightest.

units.zh: *懍遵本朝祖制，親貴不得乾預政事。
units.en: In reverent observance of this dynasty's ancestral institutions, members of the imperial clan and nobility must not interfere in government affairs.
units.literal: * In reverent observance of this dynasty's ancestral institutions, members of the imperial clan and nobility must not interfere in government affairs.

units.zh: *實行融化滿、漢畛域，所有以前一切滿、蒙官缺已經裁撤者，概不復設。
units.en: Manchu and Han boundaries shall be dissolved in practice; all Manchu and Mongol official posts previously abolished shall in no case be re-established.
units.literal: * Manchu and Han boundaries shall be dissolved in practice; all Manchu and Mongol official posts previously abolished shall in no case be re-established.

units.zh: 至通婚易俗等事，並著所司條議具奏。
units.en: As for matters such as intermarriage and changing customs, the responsible offices are also ordered to draft detailed proposals and memorialize.
units.literal: As for matters such as intermarriage and changing customs, the responsible offices are also ordered to draft detailed proposals and memorialize.

units.zh: *自宣統九年五月本日以前，凡與東西各國正式簽定條約，及已付債款合同，一律繼續有效。
units.en: All treaties formally concluded with Eastern and Western countries before this day in the fifth month of the ninth year of Xuantong, and all debt contracts already paid, shall remain in force without exception.
units.literal: * All treaties formally concluded with Eastern and Western countries before this day in the fifth month of the ninth year of Xuantong, and all debt contracts already paid, shall remain in force without exception.

units.zh: *民國所行印花稅一項，應即廢止，以紓民困；
units.en: The stamp tax instituted by the Republic shall be abolished at once to relieve the people's hardship;
units.literal: * The stamp tax instituted by the Republic shall be abolished at once to relieve the people's hardship;

units.zh: 其餘苛細雜捐，並著各省督撫查明，奏請分別裁撤。
units.en: other harsh and petty miscellaneous levies are also to be investigated by the governors of each province and memorialized for separate abolition.
units.literal: other harsh and petty miscellaneous levies are also to be investigated by the governors of each province and memorialized for separate abolition.

units.zh: *民國刑律不適國情，應即廢除，暫以宣統初年頒定現行刑律為準。
units.en: The criminal code of the Republic does not suit national conditions and shall be abolished at once; for the present the current criminal code promulgated in the early Xuantong period shall serve as the standard.
units.literal: * The criminal code of the Republic does not suit national conditions and shall be abolished at once; for the present the current criminal code promulgated in the early Xuantong period shall serve as the standard.

units.zh: *禁除黨派惡習，其從前政治罪犯，概予赦免；
units.en: Party faction and its evil practices are forbidden; all former political offenders are granted amnesty in general;
units.literal: * Party faction and its evil practices are forbidden; all former political offenders are granted amnesty in general;

units.zh: 儻有自棄於民而擾亂治安者，朕不敢赦。
units.en: if any abandon themselves before the people and disturb public order, I dare not pardon them.
units.literal: if any abandon themselves before the people and disturb public order, We dare not pardon them.

units.zh: *凡我臣民，無論已否剪髮，應遵照宣統三年九月諭旨，悉聽其便。
units.en: All my subjects, whether or not they have cut their hair, shall follow the edict of the ninth month of the third year of Xuantong and be left entirely to their own choice.
units.literal: * All Our subjects, whether or not they have cut their hair, shall follow the edict of the ninth month of the third year of Xuantong and be left entirely to their own choice.

units.zh: 凡此九條，誓共遵守。
units.en: All these nine articles we swear jointly to observe.
units.literal: All these nine articles we swear jointly to observe.

units.zh: 皇天后土，實鑑臨之！」
units.en: Heaven and Earth bear witness above!"
units.literal: Heaven and Earth bear witness above!"

units.zh: 次諭議立憲，設內閣；
units.en: A subsequent edict discussed constitutional government and the establishment of a cabinet;
units.literal: A subsequent edict discussed constitutional government and the establishment of a cabinet;

units.zh: 京、外官暫照宣統初年官制辦理；
units.en: capital and provincial offices were for the time being to follow the official system of the early Xuantong period;
units.literal: capital and provincial offices were for the time being to follow the official system of the early Xuantong period;

units.zh: 其現任文武大小官員，均照常供職。
units.en: all incumbent civil and military officials great and small were to continue in their posts as usual.
units.literal: all incumbent civil and military officials great and small were to continue in their posts as usual.

units.zh: 先後命官以勳及陳寶琛、劉廷琛等為內閣議政大臣，次則內閣閣丞萬繩栻、胡嗣瑗，大學士為瞿鴻禨、升允，顧問大臣趙爾巽、陳夔龍、張英麟、馮煦等，各部尚書梁敦彥、張鎮芳、雷震春、沈曾植、勞乃宣等，侍郎李經邁、李瑞清、陳曾壽、王乃徵、陳毅、顧瑗等，丞參辜湯生、章梫、黎湛枝、梁用弧等，都御史張曾敡，副都御史胡思敬、溫肅；
units.en: Offices were appointed in succession: Zhang Xun and Chen Baochen, Liu Tingchen, and others as cabinet deliberative ministers; next, cabinet vice directors Wan Shengqi and Hu Siyuan; grand secretaries Qu Hongji and Sheng Yun; advisory ministers Zhao Erxun, Chen Kuilong, Zhang Yinglin, Feng Xu, and others; ministers of the various boards Liang Dunyan, Zhang Zhenfang, Lei Zhenchun, Shen Zengzhi, Lao Naixuan, and others; vice ministers Li Jingmai, Li Ruiqing, Chen Zengshou, Wang Naizheng, Chen Yi, Gu Yuan, and others; assistant councillors Gu Tangsheng, Zhang Qin, Li Zhanzhi, Liang Yonghu, and others; censor-in-chief Zhang Ceng'e; vice censor-in-chief Hu Sijing and Wen Su;
units.literal: Offices were appointed in succession: Zhang Xun and Chen Baochen, Liu Tingchen, and others as cabinet deliberative ministers; next, cabinet vice directors Wan Shengqi and Hu Siyuan; grand secretaries Qu Hongji and Sheng Yun; advisory ministers Zhao Erxun, Chen Kuilong, Zhang Yinglin, Feng Xu, and others; ministers of the various boards Liang Dunyan, Zhang Zhenfang, Lei Zhenchun, Shen Zengzhi, Lao Naixuan, and others; vice ministers Li Jingmai, Li Ruiqing, Chen Zengshou, Wang Naizheng, Chen Yi, Gu Yuan, and others; assistant councillors Gu Tangsheng, Zhang Kun, Li Zhanzhi, Liang Yonghu, and others; censor-in-chief Zhang Ceng'e; vice censor-in-chief Hu Sijing and Wen Su;

units.zh: 並召鄭孝胥、吳慶坻、趙啟霖及陳邦瑞、硃益籓等均來京。
units.en: Zheng Xiaoxu, Wu Qingdi, Zhao Qilin, Chen Bangrui, Zhu Yifan, and others were also summoned to the capital.
units.literal: Zheng Xiaoxu, Wu Qingdi, Zhao Qilin, Chen Bangrui, Zhu Yifan, and others were also summoned to the capital.

units.zh: 又以勳兼直隸總督、北洋大臣，仍留京。
units.en: Zhang Xun was also made concurrent governor-general of Zhili and Beiyang minister, yet remained in the capital.
units.literal: Zhang Xun was also made concurrent governor-general of Zhili and Beiyang minister, yet remained in the capital.

units.zh: 各省督、撫、提、鎮，皆就現任者改之。
units.en: The governors, provincial governors, military governors, and commanders of each province were all reassigned from among those currently in office.
units.literal: The governors, provincial governors, military governors, and commanders of each province were all reassigned from among those currently in office.

units.zh: 命下，各省多不應，而馬廠師起，稱討逆軍，傳檄討勳，勳自請罷斥。
units.en: When the orders were issued, most provinces did not respond; then the army at Machang rose, styled itself the army to suppress rebellion, and issued a proclamation against Zhang Xun; Zhang asked to be dismissed.
units.literal: When the orders were issued, most provinces did not respond; then Duan Qirui's army rose at Mafang, styled itself the army to suppress rebellion, and issued a proclamation against Zhang Xun; Zhang Xun asked to be dismissed.

units.zh: 及攻都城，勳與戰，以兵寡不支，荷蘭公使以車迎入使館​​。
units.en: When they attacked the capital, Zhang fought them; his forces were too few to hold; the Dutch minister received him in a carriage into the legation.
units.literal: When they attacked the capital, Zhang Xun fought them; his forces were few and could not hold; the Dutch minister received him in a carriage into the legation.

units.zh: 旋赴津，居久之，卒，年七十，諡忠武。
units.en: He soon went to Tianjin, lived there a long while, and died at the age of seventy; his posthumous title was Zhongwu.
units.literal: He soon went to Tianjin, lived there a long while, and died at the age of seventy; his posthumous title was Zhongwu.

units.zh: 勳亢爽好客，待士卒有恩，所部數万人，無一斷髮者，世指為「辮子軍」。
units.en: Zhang was bold and open, hospitable to guests, and gracious to his soldiers; among his command of tens of thousands, not one had cut his queue, and the world called them the "Queue Army."
units.literal: Zhang Xun was bold and open, hospitable to guests, and gracious to his soldiers; among his command of tens of thousands, not one had cut his queue, and the world called them the "Queue Army."

units.zh: 臨戰，盡納家屬妻妾子女別室，不聽避，蓋自懟負國，誓骨肉俱殉。
units.en: On the eve of battle he gathered all his household—wives, concubines, and children—into separate quarters and would not let them flee, for he blamed himself for failing the state and swore that flesh and blood would perish together.
units.literal: On the eve of battle he gathered all his household—wives, concubines, and children—into separate quarters and would not let them flee, for he blamed himself for failing the state and swore that flesh and blood would perish together.

units.zh: 及事亟，外人破戶劫之始脫云。
units.en: When matters grew desperate, foreigners broke in and plundered the house before they escaped.
units.literal: When matters grew desperate, foreigners broke in and plundered the house before they escaped.

units.zh: 康有為，字廣廈，號更生，原名祖詒，廣東南海人。
units.en: Kang Youwei, whose style name was Guangxia and sobriquet Gengsheng, was originally named Zuyi and came from Nanhai in Guangdong.
units.literal: Kang Youwei, style name Guangxia, sobriquet Gengsheng, original name Zuyi, was a native of Nanhai in Guangdong.

units.zh: 光緒二十一年進士，用工部主事。
units.en: In the twenty-first year of Guangxu, a jinshi, he served as a secretary in the Ministry of Works.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year of Guangxu, a jinshi, he served as a secretary in the Ministry of Works.

units.zh: 少從硃次琦遊，博通經史，好公羊家言，言孔子改制，倡以孔子紀年，尊孔保教，先聚徒講學。
units.en: In youth he studied under Zhu Ciqi, mastered the classics and histories broadly, favored the Gongyang school, spoke of Confucius's institutional reforms, advocated dating by Confucius's era, honored Confucius and protected the teaching, and first gathered disciples to lecture.
units.literal: In youth he followed Zhu Ciqian in study, mastered the classics and histories broadly, favored the Gongyang school, spoke of Confucius's institutional reforms, advocated dating by Confucius's era, honored Confucius and protected the teaching, and first gathered disciples to lecture.

units.zh: 入都上萬言書，議變法，給事中餘聯沅劾以惑世誣民，非聖無法，請焚所著書。
units.en: On entering the capital he submitted a ten-thousand-word memorial advocating reform; the supervising secretary Yu Lianyuan memorialized against him for deluding the age and deceiving the people, for rejecting the sage and lacking law, and requested that his writings be burned.
units.literal: On entering the capital he submitted a ten-thousand-word memorial advocating reform; the supervising secretary Yu Lianyuan memorialized against him for deluding the age and deceiving the people, for rejecting the sage and lacking law, and requested that his writings be burned.

units.zh: 中日議款，有為集各省公車上書，請拒和、遷都、變法，格不達。
units.en: When the Sino-Japanese peace terms were negotiated, Kang gathered provincial examination candidates to submit a joint memorial requesting rejection of peace, transfer of the capital, and reform; it did not reach the throne.
units.literal: When the Sino-Japanese peace terms were negotiated, Kang gathered provincial examination candidates to submit a joint memorial requesting rejection of peace, transfer of the capital, and reform; it did not reach the throne.

units.zh: 复獨上書，由都察院代遞，上覽而善之，命錄存備省覽。
units.en: He again submitted a memorial alone, forwarded through the Censorate; the emperor read it and approved, ordering it copied and kept for reference.
units.literal: He again submitted a memorial alone, forwarded through the Censorate; the emperor read it and approved, ordering it copied and kept for reference.

units.zh: 再請誓群臣以定國是，開制度局​​以議新制，別設法律等局以行新政，均下總署議。
units.en: He again requested that the ministers swear an oath to fix the national policy, open a Bureau of Institutions to discuss new systems, and separately establish bureaus for law and the like to carry out new policies; all were referred to the Zongli Yamen for deliberation.
units.literal: He again requested that the ministers swear an oath to fix the national policy, open a Bureau of Institutions to discuss new systems, and separately establish bureaus for law and the like to carry out new policies; all were referred to the Zongli Yamen for deliberation.

units.zh: 二十四年，有為立保國會於京師，尚書李端棻，學士徐致靖、張百熙，給事中高燮曾等，先後疏薦有為才，至是始召對。
units.en: In the twenty-fourth year Kang established the Society to Protect the State in the capital; Minister Li Duanfen, Academicians Xu Zhijing and Zhang Baixi, Supervising Secretary Gao Xiezeng, and others successively memorialized recommending Kang's talent; only then was he summoned for audience.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Kang established the Society to Protect the State in the capital; Minister Li Duanfen, Academicians Xu Zhijing and Zhang Baixi, Supervising Secretary Gao Xiezeng, and others successively memorialized recommending Kang's talent; only then was he summoned for audience.

units.zh: 有為極陳：「四夷交侵，覆亡無日，非維新變舊，不能自強。
units.en: Kang stated urgently: "The four barbarians press in on every side; ruin may come any day; without renewing the old order we cannot make ourselves strong.
units.literal: Kang stated urgently: "The four barbarians press in on every side; ruin may come any day; without renewing the old order we cannot make ourselves strong.

units.zh: 變法須統籌全局而行之，遍及用人行政。」
units.en: Reform must be carried out with the whole situation planned as one, extending to personnel and administration alike."
units.literal: Reform must be carried out with the whole situation planned as one, extending to personnel and administration alike."

units.zh: 上歎曰：「奈掣肘何？」
units.en: The emperor sighed and said: "But what can be done about those who hold me back?"
units.literal: The emperor sighed and said: "But what can be done about those who hold me back?"

units.zh: 有為曰：「就皇上現有之權，行可變之事，扼要以圖，亦足救國。
units.en: Kang said: "With the authority Your Majesty already possesses, carry out what can be changed, seize the essentials and plan accordingly, and that too is enough to save the state.
units.literal: Kang said: "With the authority Your Majesty already possesses, carry out what can be changed, seize the essentials and plan accordingly, and that too is enough to save the state.

units.zh: 唯大臣守舊，當廣召小臣，破格擢用；
units.en: Since the great ministers cling to the old ways, Your Majesty should broadly summon junior officials and promote them beyond precedent;
units.literal: Since the great ministers cling to the old ways, Your Majesty should broadly summon junior officials and promote them beyond precedent;

units.zh: 並請下哀痛之詔，收拾人心。」
units.en: and also issue an edict of heartfelt grief to gather up the people's hearts."
units.literal: and also issue an edict of heartfelt grief to gather up the people's hearts."

units.zh: 上皆韙之。
units.en: The emperor approved all of this.
units.literal: The emperor approved all of this.

units.zh: 自辰入，至日昃始退，命在總理衙門章京上行走，特許專擢言事。
units.en: He entered at the hour of chen and did not withdraw until the sun declined; he was ordered to serve on detached duty as a secretary at the Zongli Yamen and specially permitted to memorialize on his own authority.
units.literal: He entered at the hour of chen and did not withdraw until the sun declined; he was ordered to serve on detached duty as a secretary at the Zongli Yamen and specially permitted to memorialize on his own authority.

units.zh: 旋召侍讀楊銳、中書林旭、主事劉光第、知府譚嗣同參預新政。
units.en: Soon the Hanlin reader Yang Rui, Secretariat drafter Lin Xu, secretary Liu Guangdi, and prefect Tan Sitong were summoned to take part in the new policies.
units.literal: Soon the Hanlin reader Yang Rui, Secretariat drafter Lin Xu, secretary Liu Guangdi, and prefect Tan Sitong were summoned to take part in the new policies.

units.zh: 有為連條議以進，於是詔定科舉新章，罷四書文，改試策論，立京師大學堂、譯書局，興農學，獎新書新器，改各省書院為學校，許士民上書言事，諭變法。
units.en: Kang submitted proposals item by item; thereupon edicts fixed new examination regulations, abolished essays on the Four Books, changed the test to policy essays, established the Imperial University at the capital and a Translation Bureau, promoted agricultural studies, rewarded new books and new devices, converted provincial academies into schools, permitted scholars and commoners to submit memorials, and proclaimed reform.
units.literal: Kang submitted proposals item by item; thereupon edicts fixed new examination regulations, abolished essays on the Four Books, changed the test to policy essays, established the Imperial University at the capital and a Translation Bureau, promoted agricultural studies, rewarded new books and new devices, converted provincial academies into schools, permitted scholars and commoners to submit memorials, and proclaimed reform.

units.zh: 裁詹事府、通政司，大理、光祿、太僕、鴻臚諸寺，及各省與總督同城之巡撫，河道總督，糧道、鹽道，並議開懋勤殿，定制度，改元易服，南巡遷都。
units.en: The Directorate of Education, the Office of Transmission, the Court of Judicature and Revision, the Court of Imperial Entertainments, the Court of the Imperial Stud, the Court of State Ceremonial, and other offices were abolished, along with provincial governors who shared a city with a governor-general, the Grand Canal director-general, grain transport intendant, and salt intendant; it was also proposed to open the Hall of Diligent Government, fix institutions, change the reign title and alter dress, and tour south to transfer the capital.
units.literal: The Directorate of Education, the Office of Transmission, the Court of Judicature and Revision, the Court of Imperial Entertainments, the Court of the Imperial Stud, the Court of State Ceremonial, and other offices were abolished, along with provincial governors who shared a city with a governor-general, the Grand Canal director-general, grain transport intendant, and salt intendant; it was also proposed to open the Hall of Diligent Government, fix institutions, change the reign title and alter dress, and tour south to transfer the capital.

units.zh: 未及行，以抑格言路，首違詔旨，盡奪禮部尚書、侍郎職。
units.en: Before these could be carried out, for obstructing the memorial route and being the first to violate the edict, all ministers and vice ministers of the Ministry of Rites were stripped of office.
units.literal: Before these could be carried out, for obstructing the memorial route and being the first to violate the edict, all ministers and vice ministers of the Ministry of Rites were stripped of office.

units.zh: 舊臣疑懼，群起指責有為，御史文悌复痛劾之。
units.en: Old officials grew suspicious and fearful; they rose together to denounce Kang; Censor Wen Ti again memorialized bitterly against him.
units.literal: Old officials grew suspicious and fearful; they rose together to denounce Kang; Censor Wen Ti again memorialized bitterly against him.

units.zh: 上先命有​​為督辦官報，复促出京。
units.en: The emperor first ordered Kang to supervise the official gazette, then urged him to leave the capital.
units.literal: The emperor first ordered Kang to supervise the official gazette, then urged him to leave the capital.

units.zh: 上雖親政，遇事仍承太后意旨，久感外侮，思變法圖強，用有為言，三月維新，中外震仰。
units.en: Although the emperor personally ruled, in affairs he still followed the empress dowager's intent; long feeling foreign humiliation, he thought to reform and strengthen the state, adopted Kang's words, and for three months carried out the Hundred Days' Reform, astonishing court and country alike.
units.literal: Although the emperor personally ruled, in affairs he still followed the empress dowager's intent; long feeling foreign humiliation, he thought to reform and strengthen the state, adopted Kang's words, and for three months carried out the Hundred Days' Reform, astonishing court and country alike.

units.zh: 唯新進驟起，機事不密，遂致害成。
units.en: Only the newly risen advanced too swiftly, affairs were not kept secret, and disaster was thereby brought to completion.
units.literal: Only the newly risen advanced too swiftly, affairs were not kept secret, and disaster was thereby brought to completion.

units.zh: 時傳將以兵圍頤和園劫太后，人心惶惑。
units.en: At the time it was rumored that troops would surround the Summer Palace to seize the empress dowager, and hearts were alarmed and unsettled.
units.literal: At the time it was rumored that troops would surround the Summer Palace to seize the empress dowager, and hearts were alarmed and unsettled.

units.zh: 上硃諭銳等籌議調和，有「朕位且不能保」之語，語具銳傳。
units.en: The emperor issued an vermilion rescript to Yang Rui and others to plan reconciliation; it contained the words "even my throne cannot be preserved," which are recorded in Yang's biography.
units.literal: The emperor issued an vermilion rescript to Yang Rui and others to plan reconciliation; it contained the words "even Our throne cannot be preserved," which are recorded in Yang's biography.

units.zh: 於是太后复垂簾，盡罷新政。
units.en: Thereupon the empress dowager again ruled from behind the curtain and abolished all the new policies.
units.literal: Thereupon the empress dowager again ruled from behind the curtain and abolished all the new policies.

units.zh: 以有為結黨營私，莠言亂政，褫職逮捕。
units.en: Kang was charged with forming factions for private gain and wicked words disturbing government; his office was stripped and he was ordered arrested.
units.literal: Kang was charged with forming factions for private gain and wicked words disturbing government; his office was stripped and he was ordered arrested.

units.zh: 有為先走免，逮其弟廣仁及楊銳等下獄，並處斬。
units.en: Kang fled first and escaped; his younger brother Guangren and Yang Rui and others were seized and imprisoned, and all were executed.
units.literal: Kang fled first and escaped; his younger brother Guangren and Yang Rui and others were seized and imprisoned, and all were executed.

units.zh: 復以有為大逆不道，構煽陰謀，頒硃諭宣示，並籍其家，懸賞購捕。
units.en: He was again charged with great treason and fomenting secret plots; a vermilion rescript was promulgated, his household goods were confiscated, and a reward was posted for his capture.
units.literal: He was again charged with great treason and fomenting secret plots; a vermilion rescript was promulgated, his household goods were confiscated, and a reward was posted for his capture.

units.zh: 有為已星夜出都航海南下，英國兵艦迎至吳淞。
units.en: Kang had already fled the capital by night and sailed south by sea; a British warship received him at Wusong.
units.literal: Kang had already fled the capital by night and sailed south by sea; a British warship received him at Wusong.

units.zh: 時傳上已幽廢，且被弒，有為草遺言，誓以身殉，將蹈海。
units.en: At the time it was rumored that the emperor had been secretly deposed and even assassinated; Kang drafted a final testament, swore to die for him, and was about to cast himself into the sea.
units.literal: At the time it was rumored that the emperor had been secretly deposed and even assassinated; Kang drafted a final testament, swore to die for him, and was about to cast himself into the sea.

units.zh: 英人告以訛傳，有為始脫走，亡命日本，流轉南洋，遍遊歐、美各國。
units.en: The English told him it was a false rumor; Kang then escaped, fled to Japan, wandered through the Southern Seas, and traveled throughout Europe and America.
units.literal: The English told him it was a false rumor; Kang then escaped, fled to Japan, wandered through the Southern Seas, and traveled throughout Europe and America.

units.zh: 所至以尊皇保國相號召，設會辦報，集貲謀再舉，屢遇艱險不少阻。
units.en: Wherever he went he rallied people under the banner of honoring the emperor and protecting the state, established societies and ran newspapers, gathered funds to plan another rising, and met many dangers without slackening.
units.literal: Wherever he went he rallied people under the banner of honoring the emperor and protecting the state, established societies and ran newspapers, gathered funds to plan another rising, and met many dangers without slackening.

units.zh: 嘗結富有會，起事江漢，皆為官兵破獲，誅其黨。
units.en: He once formed the Wealthy Society and raised a revolt in the Jianghan region; all were broken up by government troops and his partisans executed.
units.literal: He once formed the Wealthy Society and raised a revolt in the Jianghan region; all were broken up by government troops and his partisans executed.

units.zh: 連詔大索，毀所著書，閱其報章者並罪之。
units.en: The court issued successive edicts ordering a nationwide hunt; his books were destroyed, and even readers of his newspapers were punished.
units.literal: Edicts were issued in succession ordering a great search; his writings were destroyed, and those who read his newspapers were also punished.

units.zh: 初，太后議廢帝，稱病徵醫，久閉瀛台，旦夕不測。
units.en: At first the empress dowager considered deposing the emperor. Physicians were summoned on the pretext of illness; he was long confined on the Ocean Terrace, with his fate uncertain day by day.
units.literal: At first the empress dowager discussed deposing the emperor; she summoned doctors on the pretext of illness; he was long confined on the Ocean Terrace, his fate uncertain from day to day.

units.zh: 有為聞之，首發其謀，清議爭阻，外人亦起責言，兩江總督劉坤一言「君臣之分已定，中外之口難防」，始罷廢立。
units.en: When Kang heard of it he was the first to expose the plot. Qing faction memorialists disputed and blocked it, foreigners also protested, and Liangjiang governor-general Liu Kunyi said, "The bond between sovereign and minister is already settled; opinion at home and abroad cannot be silenced." Only then was the plan to depose him abandoned.
units.literal: Kang heard of it and was first to expose the plot; Qing faction memorialists disputed and blocked it; foreigners also raised reproaches; Liangjiang governor-general Liu Kunyi said, "The distinction between ruler and minister is already fixed; the mouths at home and abroad are hard to seal," and only then was deposition abandoned.

units.zh: 拳匪起，以滅洋人、殺新黨為號，太后思用以立威，遂肇大亂，凡與有為往還者，輒以康黨得奇禍。
units.en: The Boxers rose under the banner of destroying foreigners and killing reformers. The empress dowager hoped to use them to assert her authority, and great chaos followed. Anyone who had dealt with Kang was labeled a Kang partisan and met extraordinary punishment.
units.literal: The Boxers rose, taking as their banner the extermination of foreigners and the killing of the New Party; the empress dowager thought to use them to establish prestige, and thus great chaos began; all who had dealings with Kang were charged as Kang faction and met extraordinary calamity.

units.zh: 宣統三年，鄂變作，始開黨禁，戊戌政變獲咎者悉原之，於是有為出亡十餘年矣，始謀歸國。
units.en: In the third year of Xuantong (1911), when the Hubei uprising broke out, the ban on political associations was lifted and all those punished in the Wuxu coup were pardoned. Kang Youwei, who had been in exile for more than ten years, now planned to return home.
units.literal: In the third year of Xuantong, when the Hubei revolt broke out, the ban on political associations was first lifted; all who had been punished in the Wuxu coup were pardoned; thus Kang Youwei, who had been in exile for more than ten years, now planned to return home.

units.zh: 時民軍決行共和，廷議主立憲，而有為創虛君共和之議，以「中國帝制行已數千年，不可驟變，而大清得國最正，歷朝德澤淪浹人心，存帝號以統五族，弭亂息爭，莫順於此」。
units.en: At the time the revolutionary armies resolved on a republic while court debate favored constitutional monarchy, Kang Youwei advanced the plan of a republic under a powerless monarch, arguing: "China's imperial system has lasted for thousands of years and cannot be changed abruptly; yet the Great Qing gained the realm most legitimately, and the virtue of successive reigns has permeated the people's hearts. Preserving the imperial title to unite the five peoples and still contention is the most fitting course."
units.literal: At the time the revolutionary armies resolved on a republic; court debate favored constitutional monarchy; Kang Youwei proposed the doctrine of republic with a powerless monarch, arguing: "China's imperial system has lasted for thousands of years and cannot be changed abruptly; yet the Great Qing gained the realm most rightfully, and the virtue of successive reigns has permeated the people's hearts. To preserve the imperial title to unite the five peoples and quell strife is the most fitting course."

units.zh: 內閣總理大臣袁世凱徇民軍請，決改共和，遂下遜位之詔。
units.en: Grand Councillor and Prime Minister Yuan Shikai yielded to the revolutionary armies' demand, decided to adopt a republic, and issued the abdication edict.
units.literal: Prime Minister Yuan Shikai of the Grand Council yielded to the revolutionary armies' request, decided to adopt a republic, and issued the abdication edict.

units.zh: 有為知空言不足挽阻，思結握兵柄者以自重，頗遊說當局，數年無所就。
units.en: Kang knew that words alone could not hold back the tide. He sought alliances with military leaders to strengthen his position and lobbied those in power for years, but achieved nothing.
units.literal: Kang Youwei knew empty words could not hold back the tide; he thought to ally with those who held military power to strengthen his position, and frequently lobbied those in authority, but for several years achieved nothing.

units.zh: 丁巳民國六年，1917，張勛復辟，以有為為弼德院副院長。
units.en: In the dingsi year, the sixth year of the Republic (1917), Zhang Xun restored the monarchy and made Kang Youwei vice president of the Palace Lectures Institute.
units.literal: In the dingsi year, the sixth year of the Republic, 1917, Zhang Xun restored the throne; Kang Youwei was made vice president of the Palace Lectures Institute.

units.zh: 勳議行君主立憲，有為仍主虛君共和。
units.en: Zhang argued for constitutional monarchy; Kang still advocated a republic under a powerless monarch.
units.literal: Zhang argued for constitutional monarchy; Kang still advocated republic under a powerless monarch.

units.zh: 事變，有為避美國使館，旋脫歸上海。
units.en: When the restoration collapsed, Kang took refuge in the American legation, then escaped and returned to Shanghai.
units.literal: When the affair collapsed, Kang took refuge in the American legation, then escaped and returned to Shanghai.

units.zh: 甲子民國十三年，1924，移宮事起，修改優待條件，有為馳電以爭，略曰：「優待條件，系大清皇帝與民國臨時政府議定，永久有效，由英使保證，並用正式公文通告各國，以昭大信，無異國際條約。
units.en: In the jiazi year, the thirteenth year of the Republic (1924), when the palace was to be moved and the terms of favorable treatment were revised, Kang sent an urgent telegram of protest. In essence he wrote: "The terms of favorable treatment were agreed between the Qing emperor and the Republic's provisional government. They were meant to remain permanently valid, guaranteed by the British minister and formally notified to all nations—no different from an international treaty.
units.literal: In the jiazi year, the thirteenth year of the Republic, 1924, when the palace removal arose and the terms of favorable treatment were revised, Kang sent an urgent telegram in protest, which in summary read: "The terms of favorable treatment were agreed between the Great Qing emperor and the provisional government of the Republic, permanently valid, guaranteed by the British minister, and formally notified to all countries by official document to manifest great faith, no different from an international treaty.

units.zh: 今政府擅改條文，強令簽認，复敢挾兵搜宮，侵犯皇帝，侮逐后妃，抄沒寶器，不顧國信，倉卒要盟，則內而憲法，外而條約，皆可立廢，尚能立國乎？
units.en: Now the government alters the articles on its own authority, forces them to be signed, and further dares to search the palace at gunpoint, violate the emperor, insult and expel the empress and consorts, and seize imperial treasures—all without regard for national honor, pressing for a hasty settlement. If so, constitution and treaty alike may be cast aside at will. How can such a state endure?
units.literal: Now the government arbitrarily alters the articles, forces signature and acknowledgment, and further dares to bring troops to search the palace, violate the emperor, insult and expel the empress and consorts, confiscate precious vessels, disregard national faith, and press for agreement in haste—then internally the constitution and externally treaties may all be abolished at once; how can the state still stand?

units.zh: 皇上天下為公，中外共仰，豈屑與爭，實為民國羞也！」
units.en: The emperor holds the realm for the public good and is revered at home and abroad. He would never stoop to such contention—this is truly a disgrace to the Republic!"
units.literal: The emperor holds the realm for the public good and is respected at home and abroad; how could he stoop to contend? This is truly a shame to the Republic!"

units.zh: 明年，移蹕天津，有為來覲謁，以進德、修業、親賢、遠佞為言。
units.en: The following year, when the court moved to Tianjin, Kang came to audience, urging the emperor to advance in virtue, cultivate learning, draw near the worthy, and keep the crafty at a distance.
units.literal: The next year, when the court moved to Tianjin, Kang came to audience, speaking of advancing in virtue, cultivating learning, drawing near the worthy, and keeping the crafty at a distance.

units.zh: 丁卯民國十六年，1927，有為年七十，賜「壽」，手疏泣謝，歷敘恩遇及一生艱險狀，悲憤動人。
units.en: In the dingmao year, the sixteenth year of the Republic (1927), Kang turned seventy and was granted the character "Longevity." He wrote a tearful memorial of thanks, recounting the emperor's kindness and the hardships of his life—its grief and indignation deeply moving.
units.literal: In the dingmao year, the sixteenth year of the Republic, 1927, Kang reached seventy; he was granted the character "Longevity"; he wrote a memorial by hand in tears of thanks, recounting imperial favor and the hardships and dangers of his whole life; grief and indignation moved the reader.

units.zh: 時有為懷今感舊，傷痛已甚，哭笑無端。
units.en: By then Kang, brooding on the present and grieving the past, was in such pain that he wept and laughed without reason.
units.literal: At the time Kang, brooding on the present and moved by the past, was in extreme pain, weeping and laughing without cause.

units.zh: 自知將不起，遂草遺書，病卒於青島。
units.en: Knowing he would not recover, he drafted his last testament and died of illness at Qingdao.
units.literal: Knowing he would not recover, he drafted a final testament and died of illness at Qingdao.

units.zh: 有為天資瑰異，古今學術無所不通，堅於自信，每有創論，常開風氣之先。
units.en: Kang possessed an extraordinary natural gift and mastered learning ancient and modern. Confident in his convictions, he often opened new intellectual currents whenever he advanced a novel doctrine.
units.literal: Kang's natural endowment was extraordinary; ancient and modern learning he mastered without exception; firm in self-confidence, whenever he had a new doctrine he often opened the way for the age.

units.zh: 初言改制，次論大同，謂太平世必可坐致，終悟天人一體之理。
units.en: He first spoke of institutional reform, then expounded the Great Unity, holding that an age of great peace could surely be attained without struggle, and in the end came to understand Heaven and humanity as one.
units.literal: At first he spoke of institutional reform; next he discussed the Great Unity, holding that the age of great peace could surely be attained by sitting and waiting; in the end he understood the principle that Heaven and man are one body.

units.zh: 述作甚多，其著者有孔子改制考、新學偽經考、春秋董氏學、春秋筆削大義微言考、大同書、物質救國論、電通，及康子內外篇，長興學舍、萬木草堂、天遊廬講學記，各國遊記，暨文詩集。
units.en: He wrote prolifically. His major works include Inquiry into Confucius as a Reformer, Inquiry into the Forged Classics of the Xin Learning, Dong Zhongshu's Learning of the Spring and Autumn Annals, Inquiry into the Great Meaning and Subtle Words of the Spring and Autumn Annals, Book of Great Unity, Material Means to Save the Nation, Telegraphic Communication, the Inner and Outer Chapters of Master Kang, lecture records from the Changxing Academy, Wanmu Thatched Hall, and Heavenly Wanderer's Lodge, travel writings from many countries, and collected prose and poetry.
units.literal: His writings were very numerous; among his works are Inquiry into Confucius as a Reformer, Inquiry into the Forged Classics of the Xin Learning, Dong Zhongshu's Learning of the Spring and Autumn Annals, Inquiry into the Great Meaning and Subtle Words of the Spring and Autumn Annals, Book of Great Unity, Material Means to Save the Nation, Telegraphic Communication, Inner and Outer Chapters of Master Kang, Records of Lectures at the Changxing Academy, the Wanmu Thatched Hall, and the Heavenly Wanderer's Lodge, Travel Records of Various Countries, and collected prose and poetry.

units.zh: 論曰：光、宣兩朝，世變迭起，中國可謂多故矣。
units.en: The commentator says: Under the Guangxu and Xuantong emperors, upheavals followed one upon another; China may truly be said to have known troubled times.
units.literal: The commentator says: In the Guangxu and Xuantong reigns, worldly changes arose in succession; China may be said to have had many troubles.

units.zh: 其事皆分見於紀、傳。
units.en: These events are all treated separately in the annals and biographies.
units.literal: These matters are all treated separately in annals and biographies.

units.zh: 斷代為史，辛亥以後，例不能詳。
units.en: In a dynastic history, events after Xinhai cannot by rule be treated in full detail.
units.literal: When history is divided by dynasty, after Xinhai the rule cannot treat matters in detail.

units.zh: 唯丁巳復辟，甲子移官，實為遜位後兩大案，而勳與有為又與清室相終始，亦不可遂沒其人。
units.en: Only the dingsi restoration of 1917 and the jiazi palace removal of 1924 were truly the two great cases after abdication. Zhang Xun and Kang Youwei were bound up with the Qing house from first to last, and their lives likewise cannot simply be erased from the record.
units.literal: Only the dingsi restoration and the jiazi removal of the palace were in truth the two great cases after abdication; Zhang Xun and Kang Youwei moreover shared the Qing house's beginning and end, and their persons likewise cannot simply be erased.

units.zh: 明末三王及諸遺臣，史皆勿諱，今仿其體，並詳著於篇，庶幾考有清一代之本末者，有所鑑焉。
units.en: Historians did not conceal the three Ming princes of the late dynasty or their loyalist followers; following that precedent, both men are set forth here in detail, so that those who study the rise and fall of the Qing may find something to reflect upon.
units.literal: The three princes of the late Ming and the various loyalist subjects are not concealed in history; now following that form, both are set forth in detail in this chapter, so that those who examine the beginning and end of the Qing may have something to reflect upon.
