units.zh: 此卷是上卷移來的勞乃宣傳、沈曾植傳，無張勛傳、康有為傳。
units.en: In this edition the chapter contains only the biographies of Lao Naixuan and Shen Zengzhi carried over from the previous scroll, with no biographies of Zhang Xun or Kang Youwei.
units.literal: This chapter is the biographies of Lao Naixuan and Shen Zengzhi moved from the previous scroll; it has no biography of Zhang Xun or Kang Youwei.

units.zh: 傳後有論，其文是：「論曰：乃宣、曾植皆學有遠識，本其所學，使獲竟其所施，其治績當更有遠到者。
units.en: A comment follows the biographies, reading: "The commentator says: Lao and Shen both possessed learning and far-reaching insight. Had they been able fully to apply what they had learned, their achievements in government would surely have reached further.
units.literal: After the biographies there is a comment; its text reads: "The commentator says: Naixuan and Zengzhi both had learning and far-reaching insight; had they been able to carry out fully what their learning aimed at, their achievements in government would surely have reached further.

units.zh: 乃朝局遷移，掛冠神武，雖皆僑居海濱，而平居故國之思，無時敢或忘者。
units.en: Yet as the political order shifted, they resigned office. Though both lived abroad by the sea, they never dared forget their former country for a moment.
units.literal: Yet as the court situation shifted, they hung up their caps at the Gate of Divine Martiality; although both lived abroad by the sea, in daily life their thoughts of the former state they dared not forget for a moment.

units.zh: 卒至憔悴憂傷，賚志以沒。
units.en: In the end they wasted away in grief and died with their ambitions unfulfilled.
units.literal: In the end they grew haggard with grief and died with their ambitions unfulfilled.

units.zh: 悲夫！」
units.en: How lamentable!"
units.literal: Alas!"

units.zh: 〈關外一次本〉
units.en: Guanwai first edition>〉
units.literal: Guanwai first edition>〉

units.zh: 於張勛傳後附有張彪傳，全文如下：
units.en: After Zhang Xun's biography this edition appends the biography of Zhang Biao in full, as follows:
units.literal: After the biography of Zhang Xun is appended the biography of Zhang Biao; the full text is as follows:

units.zh: :張彪，字虎臣，山西榆次人。
units.en: Zhang Biao, whose style name was Huchen, came from Yuci in Shanxi.
units.literal: Zhang Biao, style name Huchen, was a native of Yuci in Shanxi.

units.zh: 以武生歸撫標，巡撫張之洞器賞之，擢外委，隨調粵、鄂至兩江。
units.en: As a military licentiate he joined the Hunan garrison. Governor Zhang Zhidong took notice of him and promoted him to outer deputy; with successive transfers he served in Guangdong, Hubei, and the lower Yangtze region.
units.literal: As a military licentiate he joined the Hunan garrison banner; Governor Zhang Zhidong valued and appreciated him, promoted him to outer deputy, and with transfers served in Guangdong, Hubei, and Liangjiang.

units.zh: 時新練陸軍，充管帶，監修江陰江防砲台。
units.en: When the new army was being trained he served as battalion commander and supervised construction of the Jiangyin Yangtze defense batteries.
units.literal: When the new army was being trained he served as battalion commander and supervised repair of the Jiangyin Yangtze defense batteries.

units.zh: 復還湖北，充護軍管帶。
units.en: He returned to Hubei and served as battalion commander of the guard army.
units.literal: He returned again to Hubei and served as battalion commander of the guard army.

units.zh: 光緒二十三年，奏派赴日本考查軍政，歸，督修漢口後湖堤工，創漢陽兵工廠。
units.en: In the twenty-third year of Guangxu he was sent to Japan to study military administration. On his return he supervised the Hankou rear-lake embankment project and founded the Hanyang arsenal.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year of Guangxu he was memorialized and dispatched to Japan to investigate military administration; on return he supervised repair of the Hankou rear-lake embankment works and founded the Hanyang arsenal.

units.zh: 累保副將，賞壯勇巴圖魯勇號，兼常備軍鎮統，授松潘總兵，留充陸軍第八軍鎮統制官。
units.en: Through repeated commendations he rose to vice general, was granted the valiant title Batulu, commanded a standing army brigade, was appointed commander at Songpan, and retained as commander of the Eighth Army Division.
units.literal: Through repeated commendations he rose to vice general, was awarded the valiant title Batulu, concurrently commanded a standing army brigade, was appointed commander at Songpan, and retained as commander of the Eighth Army Division of the army.

units.zh: 南北新軍會操於彰德，賞花翎；
units.en: When northern and southern new armies held joint maneuvers at Zhangde, he was awarded the peacock feather;
units.literal: Northern and southern new armies held joint maneuvers at Zhangde; he was awarded the peacock feather;

units.zh: 再會操太湖，更勇號曰奇穆欽。
units.en: at a second maneuver on Lake Tai his valiant title was changed to Qimuchin.
units.literal: at a second maneuver at Taihu his valiant title was changed to Qimuchin.

units.zh: 宣統二年，擢湖北提督，加陸軍副都統。
units.en: In the second year of Xuantong he was promoted to military governor of Hubei and given the additional rank of vice commander of the army.
units.literal: In the second year of Xuantong he was promoted to Hubei military governor and given the additional rank of vice commander of the army.

units.zh: 三年，新軍變，總督瑞澂棄城走，彪率衛隊巷戰，自夜至日午，不能支，退召水師。
units.en: In the third year the New Army mutinied. Governor Ruicheng abandoned the city and fled. Biao led his guard in street fighting from night until noon, could not hold, and withdrew to summon the naval forces.
units.literal: In the third year the New Army mutinied; Governor Ruicheng abandoned the city and fled; Biao led his guard in street fighting from night until noon, could not hold, withdrew and summoned the naval forces.

units.zh: 瑞澂劾以構變潛逃，詔革職，圖後效。
units.en: Ruicheng accused him of fomenting the mutiny and fleeing in secret. An edict stripped his office while reserving hope for future merit.
units.literal: Ruicheng memorialized against him for fomenting the mutiny and fleeing in secret; an edict stripped his office while reserving hope for future merit.

units.zh: 复充湘豫鄂援軍總司令，率殘軍保漢口。
units.en: He again served as commander-in-chief of the Hunan-Henan-Hubei relief army, leading remnant forces to defend Hankou.
units.literal: He again served as commander-in-chief of the Hunan-Henan-Hubei relief army, leading remnant forces to hold Hankou.

units.zh: 禁衛軍及北洋軍南下，督隊先驅，屢有克捷。
units.en: When the Imperial Guard and Beiyang armies marched south, he led the vanguard and won repeated victories.
units.literal: The Imperial Guard and Beiyang armies marched south; he directed the vanguard and repeatedly won victories.

units.zh: 既复漢陽，還原官。
units.en: After Hanyang was recovered, his original office was restored.
units.literal: After Hanyang was recovered, his original office was restored.

units.zh: 官軍請改共和，要彪署名，力欲之，遂稱病去。
units.en: When the government army sought to adopt a republic and demanded Biao's signature, he firmly refused and resigned on grounds of illness.
units.literal: The government army requested conversion to a republic and demanded Biao's signature; he strenuously refused and thereupon pleaded illness and resigned.

units.zh: 東渡日本，歸寓津，築張園自隱。
units.en: He went to Japan, then returned to Tianjin, where he built Zhang Garden and lived in seclusion.
units.literal: He crossed east to Japan, returned to lodge at Tianjin, and built Zhang Garden to live in seclusion.

units.zh: 乙丑，迎蹕駐園，供張服用，夙夜唯勤。
units.en: In the yichou year he received the imperial procession at his garden, supplied furnishings and provisions, and served diligently from dawn to dusk.
units.literal: In the yichou year he received the imperial procession lodging at the garden, supplied furnishings and provisions, and from dawn to dusk was diligent alone.

units.zh: 丁卯秋，病篤，見駕臨視，已不能起，強啟目含淚而逝，年六十八。
units.en: In the autumn of dingmao his illness grew grave. The emperor came in person to visit, but he could no longer rise. He forced his eyes open, tears streaming, and died at the age of sixty-eight.
units.literal: In the autumn of dingmao his illness grew grave; the emperor came in person to visit; he could no longer rise; he forced his eyes open, tears in them, and died at the age of sixty-eight.

units.zh: 尚書敬顯儁曰：「孔子云：『微管仲，吾其被發左衽矣』以此言之，右衽為是。」
units.en: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."
units.literal: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."

units.zh: 侍郎李端棻奏請立學，中旨報可，而樞府厭言新政，請緩行。
units.en: Vice Minister Li Duanfen memorialized asking that a university be established. The imperial rescript approved, but the Grand Council was weary of new policies and asked that implementation be delayed.
units.literal: Vice Minister Li Duanfen memorialized requesting establishment of a school. The imperial rescript approved, but the Grand Council was weary of speaking of new policies and requested postponement.

units.zh: 京師之有大學堂也，始於中日戰後。
units.en: The Imperial University in the capital dated from the period after the Sino-Japanese War.
units.literal: The Imperial University in the capital had its beginning after the Sino-Japanese War.

units.zh: 瑞澂，兩湖總督。
units.en: Ruichen was governor-general of the Two Huguang.
units.literal: Ruichen was governor-general of the Two Huguang.

units.zh: 瑞澂自有傳。
units.en: Ruichen has his own biography.
units.literal: Ruichen has his own biography.

units.zh: 孫瑞洵，烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣；
units.en: His grandson Ruixun was commissioner at Uliastai;
units.literal: His grandson Ruixun was commissioner at Uliastai;

units.zh: 迨宣統遜位，而中國數千年相傳之刑典俱廢。
units.en: When Xuantong abdicated, the penal codes that China had transmitted for thousands of years were all abolished.
units.literal: By the time Xuantong abdicated, the penal codes handed down in China for thousands of years were all abolished.

units.zh: 惟法院編制法、違警律、禁煙條例均經宣統二年頒布，與現行刑律僅行之一年，而遜位之詔下矣。
units.en: Only the Court Organization Law, Public Order Offenses Law, and Opium Prohibition Regulations were promulgated in Xuantong 2; the Current Penal Code had been in force for barely a year when the abdication edict was issued.
units.literal: Only the Court Organization Law, Public Order Offenses Law, and Opium Prohibition Regulations were all promulgated in Xuantong 2; and the Current Penal Code had been in force for only one year when the abdication edict was issued.

units.zh: 光緒六年，兩廣總督張之洞募沙民千人助守虎門，楊玉科增募千人及惠清營五百人，鄭紹忠募安勇二千人，所募鄉兵，以防勇規制編之。
units.en: In the sixth year of Guangxu, Governor-General Zhang Zhidong recruited one thousand sand-dwellers for Humen; Yang Yuke added one thousand men and five hundred for the Huiqing Camp; Zheng Shaozhong raised two thousand An braves—all organized as local militia under defensive brave regulations.
units.literal: Sixth year of Guangxu, Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of the Two Guangs recruited one thousand sand-dwellers to help garrison Humen; Yang Yuke added one thousand and five hundred for the Huiqing Camp; Zheng Shaozhong recruited two thousand An braves—all recruited local militia organized under defensive brave regulations.

units.zh: 經邁，侍郎。
units.en: Jingmai became a vice-president.
units.literal: Jingmai became a vice-president.

units.zh: 積勞嘔血薨，年七十有九。
units.en: Worn out by accumulated labor he vomited blood and died at seventy-nine.
units.literal: Worn out by accumulated labor he vomited blood and died, aged seventy-nine.

units.zh: 張英麟張仁黼張亨嘉
units.en: Zhang Yinglin, Zhang Renfu, and Zhang Hengjia
units.literal: Zhang Yinglin, Zhang Renfu, Zhang Hengjia

units.zh: 張英麟，字振卿，山東歷城人。
units.en: Zhang Yinglin, courtesy name Zhenqing, was a native of Licheng in Shandong.
units.literal: Zhang Yinglin, style name Zhenqing, was a man of Licheng in Shandong.

units.zh: 同治四年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。
units.en: In Tongzhi 4 he passed the jinshi examination, was selected a Hanlin Bachelor, and was appointed Compiler.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi he became a jinshi, was selected a Bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed Compiler.

units.zh: 英麟撰資治通鑑講章以進，皆發明精義，比附近情，冀以誠意相感動，章上，但循故事留覽而已。
units.en: Yinglin composed lecture chapters on the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government and submitted them, all elucidating refined meanings and drawing parallels close to human affairs, hoping to move others through sincerity; when the chapters were received, they were only retained for review according to routine.
units.literal: Yinglin composed lecture chapters on the Zizhi Tongjian and submitted them, all elucidating refined meanings and drawing parallels close to human feeling, hoping to move others through sincerity; when the chapters went up, they were only retained for review according to routine.

units.zh: 十三年，命偕檢討王慶祺在弘德殿行走。
units.en: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to serve with Reviser Wang Qingqi in attendance at the Hongde Hall.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to serve with Reviser Wang Qingqi in attendance at the Hongde Hall.

units.zh: 光緒十七年，以詹事授奉天府丞，兼學政。
units.en: In Guangxu 17, as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent he was appointed Vice Director of the Fengtian Prefecture and concurrently Educational Commissioner.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent he was appointed Vice Director of the Fengtian Prefecture and concurrently Educational Commissioner.

units.zh: 二十六年，通州試竣回京，兩宮西狩，官吏遷避，英麟獨守學政關防待交替。
units.en: In the twenty-sixth year, when the Tongzhou examinations were finished and he returned to the capital, the two palaces fled west; officials fled or hid; Yinglin alone guarded the educational commissioner's seal awaiting his successor.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, when the Tongzhou examinations were finished and he returned to the capital, the two palaces fled west; officials fled or hid; Yinglin alone guarded the educational commissioner's seal awaiting transfer of office.

units.zh: 二十九年，充會試副總裁，借闈河南，改試策論、經義。
units.en: In the twenty-ninth year he served as Associate Chief Examiner for the metropolitan examination, using the Henan examination grounds and changing the test to policy essays and classical exposition.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he served as Associate Chief Examiner for the metropolitan examination, borrowing the Henan examination grounds and changing the test to policy essays and classical exposition.

units.zh: 三十四年，授都御史。
units.en: In the thirty-fourth year he was appointed Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he was appointed Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 宣統改元，攝政監國，复舉輪講之典。
units.en: When Xuantong began his reign the regent supervised the state and again instituted the rotating lecture rite.
units.literal: When Xuantong began his reign the regent supervised the state and again instituted the rotating lecture rite.

units.zh: 三年，武昌變起，內閣改制，飭都察院及凡有言責者皆停奏事，英麟嘆息以為奇變。
units.en: In the third year the Wuchang uprising erupted; the Grand Secretariat was reorganized and the Censorate and all who bore duty to speak were ordered to cease submitting memorials; Yinglin sighed, taking this as an extraordinary transformation.
units.literal: In the third year the Wuchang uprising erupted; the Grand Secretariat was reorganized and the Censorate and all who bore duty to speak were ordered to cease submitting memorials; Yinglin sighed, taking this as a strange transformation.

units.zh: 乙丑冬，卒，年八十有八。
units.en: In the winter of the yichou year he died, aged eighty-eight.
units.literal: In the winter of the yichou year he died, aged eighty-eight.

units.zh: 重宴瓊林，加太子太保。
units.en: At the repeat Qionglin banquet he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: At the repeat Qionglin banquet he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 御史江春霖直劾親貴，斥回原衙門，英麟率全台合疏留之。
units.en: When Censor Jiang Chunlin directly impeached imperial kin and was sent back to his original post, Yinglin led the entire Censorate in a joint memorial to retain him.
units.literal: When Censor Jiang Chunlin directly impeached imperial kin and was sent back to his original post, Yinglin led the entire Censorate in a joint memorial to retain him.

units.zh: 二十八年，直隸總督袁世凱、兩江總督劉坤一、湖廣總督張之洞，會保刑部左侍郎沈家本、出使美國大臣伍廷芳修訂法律，兼取中西。
units.en: In the twenty-eighth year, Viceroy Yuan Shikai of Zhili, Viceroy Liu Kunyi of Liangjiang, and Viceroy Zhang Zhidong of Huguang jointly recommended Left Vice Minister of Punishments Shen Jiaben and Minister to the United States Wu Tingfang to revise the laws, combining Chinese and Western approaches.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, the Viceroy of Zhili Yuan Shikai, the Viceroy of Liangjiang Liu Kunyi, and the Viceroy of Huguang Zhang Zhidong jointly recommended the Left Vice Minister of Punishments Shen Jiaben and the Minister Plenipotentiary to the United States Wu Tingfang to revise the laws, drawing on both Chinese and Western sources.

units.zh: 自光緒變法，二十八年，山西巡撫趙爾巽奏請各省通設罪犯習藝所。
units.en: During the Guangxu reforms, in 1902 Shanxi governor Zhao Erxun memorialized for vocational training institutions for convicts in every province.
units.literal: From the Guangxu reforms, in the twenty-eighth year, the Shanxi provincial governor Zhao Erxun memorialized requesting that every province establish vocational training institutions for convicts.

units.zh: 楊銳等獲罪，崇禮以案情重大，請欽派大學士、軍機大臣會同審訊，始命軍機會刑部、都察院嚴審。
units.en: When Yang Rui and others were condemned, Chongli, judging the case grave, asked that grand secretaries and grand councillors be specially appointed to conduct a joint investigation; only then was an order issued for the Grand Council, together with the Board of Punishments and the Censorate, to conduct a strict inquiry.
units.literal: When Yang Rui and others were condemned, Chongli, because the case was grave, requested that grand secretaries and grand councillors be specially appointed to conduct a joint investigation; only then was an order issued for the Grand Council together with the Board of Punishments and the Censorate to conduct a strict inquiry.

units.zh: 已，又傳旨即行正法。
units.en: Shortly afterward, another edict ordered their immediate execution.
units.literal: Shortly afterward, another edict was transmitted ordering immediate execution.

units.zh: 詞連尚書徐世昌，侍郎楊士琦、沈雲沛，總督陳夔龍、張人駿，巡撫寶棻、恩壽等十數人。
units.en: His words implicated Ministers Xu Shichang and Vice Ministers Yang Shiqi and Shen Yunpei, Governors Chen Kuilong and Zhang Renjun, and Governors Bao Fen and En Shou and more than ten others.
units.literal: His words implicated Ministers Xu Shichang and Vice Ministers Yang Shiqi and Shen Yunpei, Governors Chen Kuilong and Zhang Renjun, and Governors Bao Fen and En Shou and more than ten others.

units.zh: 時勞乃宣充議員，與同院內閣學士陳寶琛等，於無夫奸及違犯教令二條尤力持不少怠，而分則遂未議決。
units.en: At the time Lao Naixuan served as a councilor; together with fellow councilor Grand Secretary Chen Baochen and others, he especially held firm without yielding on the two articles concerning adultery without a husband and violation of parental commands, but the Specific Provisions were never decided.
units.literal: At the time Lao Naixuan served as a councilor; together with fellow councilor Grand Secretary Chen Baochen and others, he especially held firm without slackening on the two articles concerning adultery without a husband and violation of parental commands, but the Specific Provisions were ultimately not decided.

units.zh: 將軍鐵良上聞，命覈覆死事。
units.en: General Tie Liang reported the matter to the court, which ordered an inquiry into his death in service.
units.literal: General Tie Liang reported upward, and an order was issued to verify his death in service.

units.zh: 宣統三年，簡京口副都統。
units.en: In 1911 he was appointed vice commander at Jingkou.
units.literal: In the third year of Xuantong he was selected as vice commander at Jingkou.

units.zh: 錫良周馥陸元鼎張曾敭楊士驤馮煦
units.en: [Biographies of] Xi Liang, Zhou Fu, Lu Yuanding, Zhang Cengyang, Yang Shixiang, and Feng Xu
units.literal: Xi Liang, Zhou Fu, Lu Yuanding, Zhang Cengyang, Yang Shixiang, and Feng Xu

units.zh: 二十四年，上初召用主事康有為，議行新政。
units.en: In 1898 the emperor first summoned the chief clerk Kang Youwei and discussed implementing the new policies.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the emperor first summoned and employed the chief clerk Kang Youwei and discussed implementing the new policies.

units.zh: 是年，劉坤一、張之洞等，以二十年來，各省練習洋操，屢經整頓，而舊日將領，於新操多未諳習。
units.en: That year Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong noted that after twenty years of foreign drill reforms, many old officers still did not know the new methods.
units.literal: That year Liu Kunyi, Zhang Zhidong, and others stated that over twenty years provinces had practiced foreign drill and been reorganized repeatedly, yet old commanders were mostly unversed in the new drill.

units.zh: 二十七年，以各省制兵防勇，積弊甚深，飭將軍、督、撫，就原有各營，嚴行裁汰，精選若干營，分為常備、續備、巡警等軍，更定餉章，一律操習新式槍砲。
units.en: In year 27 deep abuses in regular and brave troops led orders to cut rolls, pick elite camps for standing, reserve, and patrol forces, revise pay, and train all on modern arms.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, because regular troops and defense braves in each province had abuses too deep, generals, governors-general, and governors were ordered, starting from existing camps, to cut strictly, select certain camps, divide them into standing, reserve, and patrol forces, revise pay regulations, and uniformly drill new-style firearms and cannon.

units.zh: 東西各國教將練兵要旨，約有十二：一曰教士以禮，使知有恥自重，一曰調護士卒起處飲食，一曰講明槍砲彈藥質性源流之法，一曰槍砲線路取准之法，一曰掘濠築壘避槍砲之法，一曰馬步砲各隊擇地借勢之法，一曰測量繪圖之法，一曰隊伍分合轉變之法，一曰守衛偵探之法，一曰行軍工程製造之法，一曰籌備行軍衣糧輜重之法，一曰行軍醫藥之法。
units.en: East and West taught twelve essentials for officers: instill discipline and self-respect; care for men's food and quarters; teach ballistics and powder; teach aiming and lines of fire; teach entrenching against fire; teach terrain use for horse, foot, and guns; teach surveying and mapping; teach unit maneuvers; teach guard and reconnaissance; teach field engineering; teach logistics; and teach field medicine.
units.literal: Eastern and Western countries' essentials for teaching officers and drilling troops numbered about twelve: first, teach soldiers ritual so they know shame and self-respect; second, care for soldiers' lodging and food; third, explain methods for the nature and origin of firearms, ammunition, and powder; fourth, methods for gun lines of fire and aiming; fifth, methods for digging moats and building works to avoid gunfire; sixth, methods for cavalry, infantry, and artillery each to choose ground and use terrain; seventh, methods of surveying and mapping; eighth, methods of dividing, combining, and transforming units; ninth, methods of guard and reconnaissance; tenth, methods of march engineering and manufacture; eleventh, methods of preparing march clothing, grain, and transport; twelfth, methods of march medicine.

units.zh: 更請仿英、法之總營務處，日本之參謀部，於都城專設衙門，掌全國水陸兵制、餉章、地理繪圖、操練法式、儲備糧餉、轉運舟車、外交偵探等事。
units.en: They also asked for a capital office modeled on British and French war ministries and Japan's general staff to run national land and sea forces, pay, maps, drill, logistics, transport, and intelligence.
units.literal: They further requested imitating Britain and France's general military affairs offices and Japan's general staff, establishing a dedicated yamen in the capital to manage nationwide land and naval organization, pay regulations, geography and mapping, drill methods, grain and pay reserves, transport of boats and carts, foreign affairs and intelligence, and other matters.

units.zh: 令內外臣工合議。
units.en: Court and provincial officials were told to deliberate together.
units.literal: Civil and military officials inside and outside were ordered to discuss jointly.

units.zh: 御史趙啟霖劾芝貴，因及慶親王奕劻子載振納賄漁色事，命大臣按驗所劾，稱無左證，褫啟霖職，而芝貴亦由是罷。
units.en: Censor Zhao Qilin impeached Zhigui and extended the charge to Prince Qing Yikuang's son Zai Zhen for bribery and debauchery. The court ordered senior ministers to investigate, who reported that there was no corroborating evidence, stripped Qilin of his post, and Zhigui was dismissed as well.
units.literal: Censor Zhao Qilin impeached Zhigui and thereby involved Prince Qing Yikuang's son Zai Zhen in bribery and womanizing; grand ministers were ordered to verify the impeachment, said there was no corroboration, stripped Qilin of office, and Zhigui was also thereby dismissed.

units.zh: 紹年言御史風聞言事，啟霖無罪，爭之不得，遂稱疾。
units.en: Shaonian argued that censors were entitled to report on rumor and hearsay and that Qilin was innocent, but his protest failed and he then claimed illness.
units.literal: Shaonian said censors report affairs on hearsay, Qilin was without guilt, argued without success, and then claimed illness.

units.zh: 時奕劻握政柄，陝西巡撫恩壽與有連，總督升允劾其贓私，不報。
units.en: At the time Prince Qing Yikuang held political power. Shaanxi Governor Enshou was connected with him, and Governor-General Sheng Yun impeached Enshou for corruption, but the court took no action.
units.literal: At the time Yikuang held political power; Shaanxi governor Enshou was connected with him, and governor-general Sheng Yun impeached Enshou for corruption, but no response was given.

units.zh: 俄，解升允職。
units.en: Before long Sheng Yun was dismissed from his post.
units.literal: Before long Sheng Yun was dismissed from office.

units.zh: 是時上擢用主事康有為及知府譚嗣同等參預新政，議變法，斥舊臣，召直隸按察使袁世凱入覲，超授侍郎，統練兵。
units.en: The emperor was then promoting Kang Youwei, a secretary, and Tan Sitong, a prefect, among others to take part in the new policies; reform was debated, veteran ministers were pushed aside, and Yuan Shikai, Zhili surveillance commissioner, was summoned to court, given a leap promotion to vice minister, and placed in command of military training.
units.literal: At that time the emperor promoted and employed the secretary Kang Youwei and the prefect Tan Sitong and others to participate in the new policies, discussed reform, dismissed old ministers, summoned Zhili provincial surveillance commissioner Yuan Shikai for audience, granted him extraordinary promotion to vice minister, and put him in charge of troop training.

units.zh: 榮祿不自安，御史楊崇伊奏請太后再垂簾，於是太后复臨朝訓政，召榮祿為軍機大臣，以世凱代之，命查拿康有為，斬譚嗣同等六人於市，以上有疾，詔徵醫；
units.en: Uneasy at these developments, Rong Lu watched as Censor Yang Chongyi asked the empress dowager to resume regency behind the curtain; the empress dowager then took up government again, recalled Rong Lu as a Grand Councilor, put Yuan Shikai in his former post, ordered Kang Youwei arrested, and had Tan Sitong and five others executed in public; because the emperor was said to be ill, physicians were summoned by edict;
units.literal: Rong Lu felt ill at ease; censor Yang Chongyi memorialized asking the empress dowager to resume the curtain again; thereupon the empress dowager again held court behind the curtain to instruct in government, summoned Rong Lu as Grand Councilor, replaced him with Yuan Shikai, ordered Kang Youwei seized, executed Tan Sitong and five others in the market, and because the emperor was ill, an edict summoned physicians;

units.zh: 時江蘇提學使勞乃宣上書憲政編查館論之曰：「法律大臣會同法部奏進修改刑律，義關倫常諸條，未依舊律修入。
units.en: At the time Jiangsu provincial education commissioner Lao Naixuan wrote to the Constitutional Research Bureau, arguing: "The legal ministers, together with the Ministry of Justice, submitted the revised penal code, yet the articles concerning human relations and moral norms were not incorporated from the old code.
units.literal: At the time Jiangsu provincial education commissioner Lao Naixuan wrote to the Constitutional Research Bureau arguing: "The legal ministers, jointly with the Ministry of Justice, memorialized submitting the revised penal code, yet the articles concerning human relations and constant norms were not revised into it according to the old code.

units.zh: 明年資政院開，憲政編查館奏交院議，將總則通過。
units.en: The next year the Advisory Council convened; the Constitutional Research Bureau submitted the draft to the council for deliberation, and the General Provisions were passed.
units.literal: The next year the Advisory Council opened; the Constitutional Research Bureau memorialized submitting it to the council for deliberation, and the General Provisions were passed.

units.zh: 但於附則稱中國宗教遵孔，以綱常禮教為重。
units.en: Only in the supplementary provisions did it say that China's religion follows Confucius and that the bonds of human relations and ritual instruction weigh most heavily.
units.literal: Only in the supplementary provisions did it say that China's religion follows Confucius and that the bonds of human relations and ritual instruction are paramount.

units.zh: 如律中十惡親屬容隱，干名犯義，存留養親，及親屬相奸、相盜、相毆，發冢犯奸各條，未便蔑棄。
units.en: Such articles in the code as concealment by relatives among the Ten Abominations, offenses against names and violation of righteousness, remaining home to support parents, mutual adultery, theft, and assault among relatives, and grave-robbing adultery ought not to be cast aside lightly.
units.literal: Such articles in the code as concealment by relatives among the Ten Abominations, offenses against names and violation of righteousness, remaining home to support parents, mutual adultery, theft, and assault among relatives, and grave-robbing adultery—these should not lightly be cast aside.

units.zh: 中國人有犯以上各罪，應仍依舊律，別輯單行法，以昭懲創。
units.en: When Chinese commit the above crimes, they should still be judged under the old code in a separately compiled special law, to make punishment and deterrence clear.
units.literal: When Chinese commit the above crimes, they should still be judged under the old code, compiled separately as a special law, to manifest punishment and deterrence.

units.zh: 竊維修訂新律，本為籌備立憲，統一法權。
units.en: I respectfully consider that revising the new code was originally intended to prepare for constitutional government and unify legal authority.
units.literal: I respectfully consider that revising the new code was originally meant to prepare for constitutionalism and unify legal authority.

units.zh: 凡中國人及在中國居住之外國人，皆應服從同一法律。
units.en: All Chinese and all foreigners residing in China should be subject to the same law.
units.literal: All Chinese and all foreigners residing in China should obey the same law.

units.zh: 是此法律，本當以治中國人為主。
units.en: This law should chiefly govern the Chinese.
units.literal: This law should primarily govern Chinese.

units.zh: 今乃依舊律別輯中國人單行法，是視此新刑律專為外國人設矣。
units.en: Now to compile a separate special law for Chinese under the old code is to treat this new penal code as if it were made exclusively for foreigners.
units.literal: Now to compile a separate special law for Chinese under the old code is to treat this new penal code as designed exclusively for foreigners.

units.zh: 本末倒置，莫此為甚。
units.en: To invert root and branch—nothing could be more perverse.
units.literal: To invert root and branch—nothing could be more extreme than this.

units.zh: 草案案語謂修訂刑律，所以收回領事裁判權。
units.en: The draft's commentary says that revising the penal code is meant to reclaim consular jurisdiction.
units.literal: The draft's commentary says that revising the penal code is for reclaiming consular jurisdiction.

units.zh: 刑律內有一二條為外國人所不遵奉，即無收回裁判權之實。
units.en: If foreigners refuse to observe even one or two articles in the penal code, there is in reality no reclaiming of judicial authority.
units.literal: If one or two articles in the penal code are not observed by foreigners, there is in fact no reclaiming of judicial authority.

units.zh: 故所修刑律，專以摹仿外國為事。
units.en: Therefore the revised penal code has devoted itself exclusively to imitating foreign countries.
units.literal: Therefore the revised penal code devotes itself exclusively to imitating foreign countries.

units.zh: 此說實不盡然。
units.en: This claim is not entirely accurate.
units.literal: This claim is not entirely true.

units.zh: 泰西各國，凡外國人居其國中，無不服從其國法律，不得執本國無此律以相爭，亦不得恃本國有此律以相抗。
units.en: In all Western countries, foreigners residing within their borders must obey the laws of those countries; they may neither argue that their own country has no such law nor rely on their own country's law to resist.
units.literal: In all Western countries, whatever foreigners reside in their lands must obey the laws of those lands; they may not argue that their own country has no such law, nor rely on their own country having such a law to resist.

units.zh: 今中國修訂刑律，乃謂為收回領事裁判權，必盡舍固有之禮教風俗，一一摹仿外國。
units.en: Now, in revising China's penal code, it is said that to reclaim consular jurisdiction one must wholly abandon China's own ritual instruction and customs and imitate foreign countries one by one.
units.literal: Now in revising China's penal code, one says that to reclaim consular jurisdiction one must entirely abandon inherent ritual instruction and customs and imitate foreign countries one by one.

units.zh: 則同乎此國者，彼國有違言，同乎彼國者，此國又相反，是必窮之道也。
units.en: Then whatever matches this country, that country will reject; whatever matches that country, this country will reject—a path that can only end in deadlock.
units.literal: Then what accords with this country, that country will object to; what accords with that country, this country will oppose—the way of certain exhaustion.

units.zh: 總之一國之律，必與各國之律相同，然後乃能令國內居住之外國人遵奉，萬萬無此理，亦萬萬無此事。
units.en: In short, the notion that one country's laws must be identical with every other country's laws before foreigners residing within can be made to obey them is utterly without principle and utterly impossible.
units.literal: In sum, that one country's laws must be identical with every other country's laws before foreigners residing within can be made to obey—there is absolutely no such principle, and absolutely no such possibility.

units.zh: 以此為收回領事裁判權之策，是終古無收回之望也。
units.en: To take this as the strategy for reclaiming consular jurisdiction is to abandon all hope of ever reclaiming it.
units.literal: To take this as the strategy for reclaiming consular jurisdiction is to have no hope of reclaiming it through all time.

units.zh: 且夫國之有刑，所以弼教。
units.en: Moreover, a state maintains punishments in order to assist moral instruction.
units.literal: Moreover, a state has punishments in order to assist instruction.

units.zh: 一國之民有不遵禮教者，以刑齊之。
units.en: When the people of a state fail to observe ritual instruction, punishments are used to bring them into line.
units.literal: When the people of a state do not observe ritual instruction, punishments are used to bring them into alignment.

units.zh: 所謂禮防未然，刑禁已然，相輔而行，不可缺一者也。
units.en: This is what is meant by saying that ritual guards against what has not yet happened and punishments restrain what has already happened: the two assist each other, and neither can be dispensed with.
units.literal: What is called ritual guarding against what has not yet happened and punishments restraining what has already happened—they proceed in mutual assistance and neither may be lacking.

units.zh: 故各省簽駁草案，每以維持風化立論，而案語乃指為渾道德法律為一。
units.en: Therefore, when the various provinces annotated objections to the draft, they often argued from the need to uphold public morals, yet the commentary denounced this as conflating morality and law.
units.literal: Therefore the various provinces, in annotating objections to the draft, often argued from maintaining public morals, yet the commentary denounced this as conflating morality and law into one.

units.zh: 其論無夫奸曰：『國家立法，期於令行禁止。
units.en: Its discussion of adultery without a husband says: "When the state makes laws, it expects them to be enforced and obeyed.
units.literal: Its discussion of adultery without a husband says: "When the state legislates, it expects orders to be enforced and prohibitions obeyed.

units.zh: 有法而不能行，轉使民玩法而肆無忌憚。
units.en: When laws exist but cannot be enforced, the people treat the law as a game and act without restraint.
units.literal: When there is law but it cannot be enforced, it only makes the people treat the law as a game and act without restraint.

units.zh: 和姦之事，幾于禁之無可禁，誅之不勝誅，即刑章具在，亦祗具文。
units.en: In cases of consensual adultery, prohibition is nearly impossible and punishment cannot keep pace; even when the penal code is complete, it remains only words on paper.
units.literal: In cases of consensual adultery, prohibition is nearly impossible and punishment cannot keep pace; even with the penal code complete, it is only text on paper.

units.zh: 必教育普及，家庭嚴正，輿論之力盛，廉恥之心生，然後淫靡之風可少衰。』
units.en: Only when education is widespread, households are strict, public opinion is strong, and a sense of shame takes root can the tide of debauchery begin to recede.
units.literal: Only when education is widespread, households are strict, the force of public opinion is strong, and a sense of shame arises can the tide of debauchery somewhat abate.

units.zh: 又曰：『防遏此等醜行，不在法律而在教化。
units.en: It also says: "To check such vile conduct lies not in law but in moral instruction."
units.literal: It also says: "To check such vile conduct lies not in law but in moral instruction."

units.zh: 即列為專條，亦無實際。』
units.en: Even if such conduct were made the subject of separate articles, there would be no practical effect."
units.literal: Even if set forth as separate articles, there is no practical effect."

units.zh: 其立論在離法律與道德教化而二之，視法律為全無關於道德教化，故一意摹仿外國，而於舊律義關倫常諸條棄之如遺，焉用此法為乎？」
units.en: Its argument separates law from moral instruction, treating law as wholly unrelated to moral instruction; therefore it single-mindedly imitates foreign countries and casts aside the old code's articles on human relations and moral norms like rubbish—of what use is such a law?"
units.literal: Its argument separates law from moral instruction into two, treating law as wholly unrelated to moral instruction; therefore it single-mindedly imitates foreign countries and casts aside like rubbish the old code's articles on human relations and constant norms—of what use is such a law?"

units.zh: 謂宜將舊律有關禮教倫紀各節，逐一修入正文，並擬補干名犯義、犯罪存留養親、親屬相奸相毆、無夫奸、子孫違犯教令各條。
units.en: He urged that each section of the old code concerning ritual instruction and ethical order be incorporated one by one into the main text, and proposed adding articles on offenses against names and violation of righteousness, offenders remaining home to support parents, mutual adultery and assault among relatives, adultery without a husband, and descendants violating parental commands.
units.literal: He urged that each section of the old code concerning ritual instruction and ethical order be revised one by one into the main text, and proposed supplementing articles on offenses against names and violation of righteousness, offenders remaining home to support parents, mutual adultery and assault among relatives, adultery without a husband, and descendants violating parental commands.

units.zh: 李端棻 徐致靖 子仁鑄 陳寶箴 黃遵憲 曾鉌 楊深秀 楊銳 劉光第 譚嗣同 唐才常 林旭 康廣仁 李端棻，字苾園，貴州貴筑人。
units.en: Li Duanfen, Xu Zhijing, his son Renzhu, Chen Baozhen, Huang Zunxian, Zeng He, Yang Shenxiu, Yang Rui, Liu Guangdi, Tan Sitong, Tang Caichang, Lin Xu, and Kang Guangren. Li Duanfen, whose courtesy name was Biyuan, came from Guizhu in Guizhou.
units.literal: Li Duanfen, Xu Zhijing, son Renzhu, Chen Baozhen, Huang Zunxian, Zeng He, Yang Shenxiu, Yang Rui, Liu Guangdi, Tan Sitong, Tang Caichang, Lin Xu, and Kang Guangren. Li Duanfen, courtesy name Biyuan, was a native of Guizhu in Guizhou.

units.zh: 林旭，字暾谷，福建侯官人。
units.en: Lin Xu, whose courtesy name was Tangu, came from Houguan in Fujian.
units.literal: Lin Xu, courtesy name Tangu, was a native of Houguan in Fujian.

units.zh: 旭為閩學會領袖，又充保國會會員。
units.en: Xu led the Fujian Study Society and also joined the Baoguo Society.
units.literal: Xu was leader of the Fujian Study Society and also served as a member of the Society for the Preservation of the Nation.

units.zh: 入貲為內閣中書。
units.en: He bought appointment as a secretary in the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: He purchased appointment as a secretary in the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 退繕摺，上稱善，遂命與譚嗣同等同參機務，詔諭多旭起草。
units.en: He then revised his memorial, which the Emperor praised, and was ordered to join Tan Sitong and the others in confidential duties; many edicts were drafted by Xu.
units.literal: He withdrew and drafted a memorial; the Emperor praised it, then ordered him to join Tan Sitong and the others in participating in confidential affairs, and many edicts were drafted by Xu.

units.zh: 著有晚翠軒詩集。
units.en: He wrote Wancuixuan shiji.
units.literal: His writings include Wancuixuan shiji.

units.zh: 年十九，舉本省鄉試第一。
units.en: At nineteen he topped the provincial examinations in Fujian.
units.literal: At nineteen he placed first in the provincial examination of his province.

units.zh: 及變起，同戮於市，年二十有四。
units.en: When the coup came he was executed in the marketplace with the others, aged twenty-four.
units.literal: When the coup broke out he was executed in the marketplace together with the others, at the age of twenty-four.

units.zh: 妻沈葆楨孫女，聞變，仰藥不死，以毀卒。
units.en: His wife was Shen Baozhen's granddaughter; on hearing the news she took poison but survived, and died of grief.
units.literal: His wife was a granddaughter of Shen Baozhen; when she heard of the disaster she took poison but did not die, and died of grief.

units.zh: 銳、光第、嗣同、旭及深秀、廣仁同日被禍，世稱「六君子」，皆悲其志。
units.en: Rui, Guangdi, Sitong, Xu, Shenxiu, and Guangren were executed on the same day; the world called them the "Six Gentlemen," and all mourned their purpose.
units.literal: Rui, Guangdi, Sitong, Xu, Shenxiu, and Guangren suffered disaster on the same day; the world called them the "Six Gentlemen," and all mourned their purpose.

units.zh: 器量尤廣，庚子，外人請懲禍首戮大臣，編修劉廷琛謂失國體，責宰輔不能爭，家鼐揖而引過。
units.en: His breadth of character was especially remarkable. In the gengzi year foreigners demanded that those responsible be punished and senior ministers executed. Compiler Liu Tingchen said this would disgrace the state and blamed the chief ministers for failing to object. Jianai bowed and took the blame upon himself.
units.literal: His breadth of mind was especially great. In the gengzi year foreigners demanded punishment of those responsible and execution of great ministers. Compiler Liu Tingchen said this would lose national dignity and blamed the chief ministers for failing to protest. Jianai bowed and took the blame upon himself.

units.zh: 家鼐獨保廷琛，謂曩以大義見責，知忠鯁必不負國，世皆稱之。
units.en: Jianai alone recommended Tingchen, saying that because he had once been rebuked for upholding a great principle, one could know that as a loyal and forthright man he would not fail the state. The world praised him for it.
units.literal: Jianai alone recommended Tingchen, saying that because he had once been rebuked on grounds of great principle, one knew that as a loyal and forthright man he would not fail the state. The world praised him for this.

units.zh: 徐會灃四月戊戌遷。吳廷芬左都御史。九月丙午病免。鹿傳霖左都御史。九月丁丑遷。瞿鴻禨左都御史。九月戊子遷。張百熙補。
units.en: On the wuxu day of the fourth month, Xu Huifeng was transferred. Wu Tingfen: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the bingwu day of the ninth month, was relieved due to illness. Lu Chuanlin: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the dingchou day of the ninth month, was transferred. Qu Hongji: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the wuzi day of the ninth month, was transferred. Zhang Baixi was appointed to fill the vacancy.
units.literal: On the wuxu day of the fourth month, Xu Huifeng was transferred. Wu Tingfen: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the bingwu day of the ninth month, was relieved due to illness. Lu Chuanlin: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the dingchou day of the ninth month, was transferred. Qu Hongji: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the wuzi day of the ninth month, was transferred. Zhang Baixi was appointed to fill the vacancy.

units.zh: 光緒二十六年庚子
units.en: The twenty-sixth year of the Guangxu reign, gengzi cycle year.
units.literal: Guangxu year 26, gengzi.

units.zh: 各國親王覲見儀，始光緒二十四年。
units.en: The protocol for audiences with foreign princes began in the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu.
units.literal: The protocol for audiences with foreign princes began in the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu.

units.zh: 德國親王亨利入覲，帝幸頤和園，御仁壽殿，亨利公服入，遞國書，帝慰勞之。
units.en: The German Prince Henry was received in audience; the emperor went to the Summer Palace and held court in the Hall of Benevolent Longevity; Prince Henry entered in formal dress, presented his credentials, and the emperor comforted him.
units.literal: The German Prince Henry was received in audience; the emperor went to the Summer Palace and held court in the Hall of Benevolent Longevity; Prince Henry entered in formal dress, presented his credentials, and the emperor comforted him.

units.zh: 既，亨利慾覲皇太后，帝奉懿旨代見。
units.en: Afterward Prince Henry wished to pay respects to the empress dowager; the emperor received him on her behalf by her express command.
units.literal: Afterward Prince Henry wished to pay respects to the empress dowager; the emperor received him on her behalf by her express command.

units.zh: 然後奉國書進，慶親王降左階接受，陳玉案，亨利等又一鞠躬，帝頷首答之，操國語慰勞。
units.en: They then advanced to present their credentials; Prince Qing descended the left steps to receive them and placed them on the jade table; Prince Henry and the others bowed again, and the emperor nodded in reply and offered words of comfort in the national language.
units.literal: They then advanced to present their credentials; Prince Qing descended the left steps to receive them and placed them on the jade table; Prince Henry and the others bowed again, and the emperor nodded in reply and offered words of comfort in the national language.

units.zh: 德繙譯官譯畢，亨利等又一鞠躬，帝仍頷首答之。
units.en: When the German interpreter had finished translating, Prince Henry and the others bowed again, and the emperor again nodded in reply.
units.literal: When the German interpreter had finished translating, Prince Henry and the others bowed again, and the emperor again nodded in reply.

units.zh: 齎奏國書，必自中門入，帝必躬親接受。
units.en: When bearing memorials and credentials, they must enter through the central gate, and the emperor must personally receive them.
units.literal: When bearing memorials and credentials, they must enter through the central gate, and the emperor must personally receive them.

units.zh: 設宴乾清宮，帝必躬親入座。
units.en: Banquets were to be held in the Palace of Heavenly Purity, and the emperor must personally take his seat.
units.literal: Banquets were to be held in the Palace of Heavenly Purity, and the emperor must personally take his seat.

units.zh: 二十七年，聯軍平拳匪，各國挾求更改禮節。
units.en: In the twenty-seventh year, the allied armies suppressed the Boxer rebels, and the various powers demanded changes to ceremonial protocol.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the allied armies suppressed the Boxer rebels, and the various powers demanded changes to ceremonial protocol.

units.zh: 是日巳刻，御玉瀾堂，亨利偕德使海靖等入，外部司官引殿東便門外入布幄少憩。
units.en: That day at the si hour, the emperor held court at the Hall of Jade Ripples; Prince Henry entered together with the German envoy Heyking and others; officials of the foreign ministry led them in through the east side gate of the hall to rest briefly in the canvas tent.
units.literal: That day at the si hour, the emperor held court at the Hall of Jade Ripples; Prince Henry entered together with the German envoy Heyking and others; officials of the foreign ministry led them in through the east side gate of the hall to rest briefly in the canvas tent.

units.zh: 駕至，扈從如儀，鳴鞭三，升座。
units.en: When the imperial procession arrived, the escort formed as prescribed; the whip was cracked three times, and the emperor ascended the throne.
units.literal: When the imperial procession arrived, the escort formed as prescribed; the whip was cracked three times, and the emperor ascended the throne.

units.zh: 慶親王等侍左右，外部長官率亨利等自中門入，北鄉一鞠躬，行數武又一鞠躬，至龍柱前又一鞠躬。
units.en: Prince Qing and others attended at his sides; the chief of the foreign ministry led Prince Henry and the others in through the central gate; facing north, they bowed once, after several paces bowed again, and upon reaching the dragon pillars bowed once more.
units.literal: Prince Qing and others attended at his sides; the chief of the foreign ministry led Prince Henry and the others in through the central gate; facing north, they bowed once, after several paces bowed again, and upon reaching the dragon pillars bowed once more.

units.zh: 而新內閣又成立，總理大臣袁世凱議修和息戰禍，取隆裕太后懿旨，頒示天下，改建國體，於是遜位詔下矣。
units.en: A new cabinet was formed; Prime Minister Yuan Shikai sought peace to end the war, secured an edict from Empress Dowager Longyu, and proclaimed a change of polity to the empire—and so the abdication decree came down.
units.literal: Then a new cabinet was formed; Prime Minister Yuan Shikai proposed peace to end the calamity of war, obtained an edict from Empress Dowager Longyu, and promulgated it throughout the realm to change the form of state—and thus the abdication edict was issued.

units.zh: 太后令磋商優待條件，授太保。
units.en: The empress dowager ordered negotiations on favorable terms for the abdication and appointed him Grand Guardian.
units.literal: The empress dowager ordered negotiation of favorable treatment terms and appointed him Grand Guardian.

units.zh: 及孝定景皇后升遐，奉安崇陵，恭送如禮，自原留守陵寢，遂命管理崇陵種樹事。
units.en: When Empress Dowager Xiaoding Jing passed away and was interred at Chongling, he escorted her with full rites; having asked to remain and guard the mausoleum, he was ordered to manage tree-planting at Chongling.
units.literal: When Empress Dowager Xiaoding Jing passed away and was interred at Chongling, he escorted her with full rites; having himself requested to remain and guard the mausoleum, he was ordered to manage tree-planting at Chongling.

units.zh: 康廣仁，名有溥，以字行，有為弟。
units.en: Kang Guangren, whose personal name was Youpu and who went by his courtesy name, was Kang Youwei's younger brother.
units.literal: Kang Guangren, personal name Youpu, styled by his courtesy name, was Kang Youwei's younger brother.

units.zh: 少從兄學。
units.en: From youth he studied under his brother.
units.literal: From youth he studied under his elder brother.

units.zh: 有為上書請改革，廣仁謂當先變科舉，庶人才可出。
units.en: When Youwei memorialized for reform, Guangren urged that the examinations be changed first so talent could emerge.
units.literal: When Youwei memorialized requesting reform, Guangren said that the examinations should be changed first, so that talent might emerge.

units.zh: 有為走，廣仁被逮。
units.en: Youwei escaped; Guangren was arrested.
units.literal: Youwei fled, and Guangren was arrested.

units.zh: 於是廣仁語有為：「今科舉既廢，宜且南歸興學專教育，俟養成多數有用才，數年後乃可云改革也。」
units.en: Guangren then told Youwei, "With the examinations gone, you should go south and devote yourself to education, train many useful men, and only after several years speak of reform again."
units.literal: Guangren then told Youwei: "Now that the examinations have been abolished, you should for the moment return south, promote schools, and devote yourself to education. Wait until a large number of useful talents have been trained; only after several years can reform be spoken of."

units.zh: 在獄言笑自若，臨刑猶言曰：「中國自強之機在此矣！」
units.en: In prison he was calm and even cheerful; at the block he still said, "China's chance to strengthen itself lies in this!"
units.literal: In prison he talked and laughed as usual; at his execution he still said: "China's opportunity to strengthen itself lies here!"

units.zh: 其後罷鄉會試、製藝，而歲科試未變，廣仁激勵言官抗疏論之，得旨俞允。
units.en: After the provincial and metropolitan examinations and the eight-legged essay were abolished, the annual local tests remained unchanged; Guangren pressed censors to memorialize boldly, and the Emperor approved.
units.literal: After the provincial and metropolitan examinations and the eight-legged essay were abolished, the annual and triennial examinations had not yet changed. Guangren stirred the censors to submit forceful memorials on the matter, and obtained an approving edict.

units.zh: 徐致靖，字子靜，江蘇宜興人，寄籍宛平。
units.en: Xu Zhijing, whose courtesy name was Zijing, came from Yixing in Jiangsu and was registered at Wanping.
units.literal: Xu Zhijing, courtesy name Zijing, was a native of Yixing in Jiangsu, with registered domicile at Wanping.

units.zh: 致靖嘗憂外患日迫，思所以為獻納計。
units.en: Zhijing had long been troubled by the daily tightening of foreign pressure and pondered how he might advise the throne.
units.literal: Zhijing had long been troubled by foreign pressure growing daily more urgent and pondered how he might offer advice to the throne.

units.zh: 光緒二年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。
units.en: In Guangxu 2 he took his jinshi degree, entered the Hanlin as a junior compiler, and was appointed a compiler.
units.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a junior compiler, and appointed compiler.

units.zh: 罷斥禮部尚書許應騤等阻遏言路，遂命致靖權右侍郎。
units.en: Minister of Rites Xu Yingkui and others who had obstructed memorials to the throne were removed, and Zhijing was appointed acting right vice minister.
units.literal: Minister of Rites Xu Yingkui and others who had obstructed the channels of remonstrance were removed, and Zhijing was appointed acting right vice minister.

units.zh: 致靖遂上言：「國是未定，請申乾斷示從違。」
units.en: Zhijing then memorialized: "The nation's course is still unsettled; I ask that Your Majesty's own judgment be made explicit, showing what is to be adopted and what rejected."
units.literal: Zhijing then memorialized: "The nation's course is still unsettled; I request that Your Majesty's own judgment be made explicit, showing what is to be adopted and what rejected."

units.zh: 未幾，詔果求通才，於是致靖奏有為堪大用，並及梁啟超、黃遵憲等。
units.en: Soon an edict did call for broadly talented men; Zhijing then reported that Kang Youwei was fit for high office, and also named Liang Qichao, Huang Zunxian, and others.
units.literal: Before long an edict indeed called for men of broad ability; Zhijing then memorialized that Youwei was fit for great employment, and also named Liang Qichao, Huang Zunxian, and others.

units.zh: 父憂服闋，二十三年，起故官。
units.en: After completing mourning for his father, in the twenty-third year he was recalled to his former office.
units.literal: When his mourning for his father was completed, in the twenty-third year he was recalled to his former post.

units.zh: 二十四年八月，太后復出訓政，參預新政諸臣皆獲罪。
units.en: In the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year the empress dowager resumed control of government, and every official who had joined the reform movement was punished.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year the empress dowager resumed regency, and all the officials who had taken part in the new policies were punished.

units.zh: 庚子，聯軍陷京師，致靖始出獄待罪，詔赦免。
units.en: In the gengzi year, when the allied armies occupied Beijing, Zhijing was released from prison to await sentence, and an edict granted him amnesty.
units.literal: In the gengzi year, when the allied armies occupied the capital, Zhijing was first released from prison to await sentence, and an edict granted him amnesty.

units.zh: 子仁鑄，時以編修督湘學，倡新學，書告致靖舉康有為。
units.en: His son Renzhu, then a compiler serving as Hunan's educational commissioner, promoted the new learning and wrote urging Zhijing to recommend Kang Youwei.
units.literal: His son Renzhu, then a compiler serving as educational commissioner of Hunan, promoted the new learning and wrote telling Zhijing to recommend Kang Youwei.

units.zh: 復以邊患棘，宜練重兵，力荐袁世凱主軍事。
units.en: He further urged that with border crises pressing, large forces should be drilled, and strongly recommended Yuan Shikai to direct military affairs.
units.literal: He further urged that with border troubles urgent, heavy forces should be trained, and strongly recommended Yuan Shikai to direct military affairs.

units.zh: 累遷侍讀學士。
units.en: He rose in stages to reader-in-waiting in the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to reader-in-waiting in the Hanlin Academy.

units.zh: 致靖褫職坐系，尋定永遠監禁，仁鑄亦罷官。
units.en: Zhijing was stripped of rank and imprisoned; he was soon sentenced to lifelong detention, and Renzhu was dismissed from office as well.
units.literal: Zhijing was stripped of office and imprisoned; soon he was sentenced to lifelong detention, and Renzhu was also dismissed from office.

units.zh: 卒，年七十五。
units.en: He died at the age of seventy-five.
units.literal: He died at the age of seventy-five.

units.zh: 藉以覘上意。
units.en: In this way he hoped to discern the emperor's intentions.
units.literal: Thus he sought to gauge the emperor's mind.

units.zh: 又連上書請廢製藝，改試策論，省冗官，酌置散卿。
units.en: He also sent a series of memorials asking to abolish the eight-legged essay, test policy essays instead, cut redundant offices, and appoint honorary grand secretaries as appropriate.
units.literal: He also submitted successive memorials requesting the abolition of the examination essay, replacement by policy discourse, reduction of superfluous offices, and the considered establishment of honorary grand secretaries.

units.zh: 沈曾植，字子培，浙江嘉興人。
units.en: Shen Cengzhi, whose courtesy name was Zipei, came from Jiaxing in Zhejiang.
units.literal: Shen Cengzhi, courtesy name Zipei, was a native of Jiaxing in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 曾植為學兼綜漢、宋，而尤深於史學掌故，後專治遼、金、元三史，及西北輿地，南洋貿遷沿革。
units.en: Cengzhi's learning combined Han and Song traditions, but he was especially deep in historical precedent; later he specialized in the Liao, Jin, and Yuan histories, northwestern geography, and the commercial history of the southern seas.
units.literal: Cengzhi's learning combined Han and Song learning, yet he was especially deep in historical precedent; later he specialized in the histories of Liao, Jin, and Yuan, and in the geography of the northwest and the commercial history of the southern seas.

units.zh: 光緒六年進士，用刑部主事。
units.en: In the sixth year of Guangxu he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu he passed as jinshi and was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice.

units.zh: 居刑曹十八年，專研古今律令書，由大明律、宋律統、唐律上溯漢、魏，於是有漢律輯補、晉書刑法志補之作。
units.en: For eighteen years in the Penal Code Office he studied books of laws and ordinances ancient and modern, tracing from the Ming Code and Song Statutes and Tang Code back to Han and Wei, and produced Collected Supplements to Han Law and Supplements to the Jin History Treatise on Punishments.
units.literal: For eighteen years in the Penal Code Office he devoted himself to books on laws and ordinances ancient and modern, tracing from the Ming Code and Song Statutes and Tang Code back to Han and Wei, and thus produced Collected Supplements to Han Law and Supplements to the Jin History Treatise on Punishments.

units.zh: 事親孝，母多疾，醫藥必親嘗，終歲未嘗解衣安臥，遂通醫。
units.en: He was deeply filial; his mother was often ill, and he always tasted her medicines himself, going a full year without undressing to sleep comfortably, and in this way came to master medicine.
units.literal: He served his parents with filial piety; his mother was often ill, and he always tasted medicines himself, going a full year without undressing to sleep at ease, and thus came to master medicine.

units.zh: 著有海日樓文詩集。
units.en: His writings include the Collected Essays and Poems of the Hairilou.
units.literal: His writings include Collected Essays and Poems of the Hairilou.

units.zh: 拳亂啟釁，曾植與盛宣懷等密商保護長江之策，力疾走江、鄂，決大計於劉坤一、張之洞，而以李鴻章主其成，所謂「畫保東南約」也。
units.en: When the Boxer troubles began, Cengzhi joined Sheng Xuanhuai and others in secretly planning to protect the Yangzi; despite illness he hurried to Jiangsu and Hubei, settled the great decision with Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong, and had Li Hongzhang bring it to completion—the so-called "Southeast Mutual Protection Pact."
units.literal: When the Boxer troubles began, Cengzhi with Sheng Xuanhuai and others secretly discussed plans to protect the Yangzi; forcing himself on despite illness he went to Jiangsu and Hubei, settled the great decision with Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong, and had Li Hongzhang bring it to completion—the so-called "Southeast Mutual Protection Pact."

units.zh: 三十二年，署布政使，尋護巡撫。
units.en: In the thirty-second year he acted as provincial treasurer and soon served as acting governor.
units.literal: In the thirty-second year he acted as provincial treasurer and soon guarded the governorship.

units.zh: 值江、鄂、皖三省軍會操太湖，而適遭國卹，群情忷忷，民一日數驚，城外砲馬兵又譁變。
units.en: Armies from Jiangsu, Hubei, and Anhui were holding joint maneuvers at Taihu just as the court went into mourning; popular feeling was agitated, the people were alarmed several times a day, and outside the city artillery and cavalry troops mutinied as well.
units.literal: It happened that armies of Jiangsu, Hubei, and Anhui held joint maneuvers at Taihu, and just then the nation suffered imperial mourning; popular feeling was agitated, the people were alarmed several times a day, and outside the city artillery and cavalry troops also mutinied.

units.zh: 曾植聞之，登城守禦，檄協統餘大鴻馳入江防，楚材兵艦擊毀東門外砲兵壁壘，黃鳳岐奪回菱湖嘴火藥局，一日而亂定。
units.en: When Cengzhi heard of it, he mounted the wall to organize the defense; he ordered Assistant Commander Yu Dahong to rush to the river defenses, the gunboat Chucai to destroy the artillery works outside the east gate, and Huang Fengqi to recover the Linghuzui powder magazine—and in a single day the disorder was quelled.
units.literal: When Cengzhi heard of it, he mounted the wall to defend; he ordered Assistant Commander Yu Dahong to hurry into river defense, the Chucai gunboat to destroy the artillery breastworks outside the east gate, and Huang Fengqi to recover the Linghuzui powder magazine—in one day the disorder was settled.

units.zh: 丁巳復辟，授學部尚書。
units.en: At the 1917 restoration he was appointed Minister of Education.
units.literal: At the 1917 restoration he was appointed Minister of Education.

units.zh: 事變歸，臥病海上，壬戌冬，卒，年七十三。
units.en: When events turned he went home and lay ill on the coast; in the winter of the renxu year he died at seventy-three.
units.literal: When events turned he returned home and lay ill on the coast; in the winter of the renxu year he died, aged seventy-three.

units.zh: 乃宣、曾植皆碩學有遠識，惓惓不忘，卒憂傷憔悴以死。
units.en: Naixuan and Cengzhi were both great scholars of far sight who never slackened in devotion, and in the end died worn down by grief.
units.literal: Naixuan and Cengzhi were both great scholars of far sight, never forgetting their devotion, and in the end died worn by grief and emaciation.

units.zh: 文悌江春霖
units.en: Wen Ti and Jiang Chunlin
units.literal: Wen Ti, Jiang Chunlin

units.zh: 文悌，字仲恭，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正黃旗人。
units.en: Wen Ti, styled Zhonggong, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
units.literal: Wen Ti, styled Zhonggong, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

units.zh: 以筆帖式歷戶部郎中，出為河南知府，改御史。
units.en: From clerk he rose through director in the Ministry of Revenue, went out as prefect of Henan, and was changed to censor.
units.literal: From clerk he rose through director in the Ministry of Revenue, went out as prefect of Henan, and was changed to censor.

units.zh: 文悌以言官為人指使，黨庇報復，紊亂臺諫，遂上疏言：「康有為向不相識，忽踵門求謁，送以所著書籍，閱其著作，以變法為宗。
units.en: Wen Ti, holding that remonstrating officials were directed by others, engaged in factional shielding and revenge, and threw the censorate into disorder, therefore memorialized: "Kang Youwei was previously unknown to me when he suddenly came to my door seeking an audience and presented his writings; reading them, I found reform to be his doctrine.
units.literal: Wen Ti, as a remonstrating official acting at others' direction, factionally shielded revenge and confused the censorate, and therefore memorialized: "Kang Youwei was previously unknown to me when he suddenly came to my door seeking an audience and presented his writings; reading them, I found reform to be his doctrine.

units.zh: 而尤堪駭詫者，託辭孔子改制，謂孔子作春秋西狩獲麟為受命之符，以春秋變週為孔子當一代王者。
units.en: What is still more shocking is that under the pretext of Confucius' reform he says Confucius, when the Spring and Autumn Annals records the capture of the lin west of the hunt, took it as a token of receiving the mandate, and that changing Zhou through the Spring and Autumn means Confucius should be king of an age.
units.literal: What is still more shocking is that under the pretext of Confucius' reform he says Confucius, when the Spring and Autumn Annals records the capture of the lin west of the hunt, took it as a token of receiving the mandate, and that changing Zhou through the Spring and Autumn means Confucius should be king of an age.

units.zh: 明似推崇孔子，實則自申其改制之義。
units.en: Outwardly he seems to honor Confucius; in fact he expounds his own doctrine of reform.
units.literal: Outwardly he seems to honor Confucius; in fact he expounds his own doctrine of reform.

units.zh: 乃知康有為之學術，正如漢書嚴助所謂以春秋為蘇秦縱橫者耳。
units.en: Thus Kang Youwei's learning is just as Yan Zhu in the Book of Han said of using the Spring and Autumn for Su Qin's vertical and horizontal alliances.
units.literal: Thus Kang Youwei's learning is just as Yan Zhu in the Book of Han said of using the Spring and Autumn for Su Qin's vertical and horizontal alliances.

units.zh: 及聆其談治術，則專主西學，以師法日本為良策。
units.en: When I heard him discuss statecraft, he exclusively advocated Western learning and taking Japan as teacher as the good policy.
units.literal: When I heard him discuss statecraft, he exclusively advocated Western learning and taking Japan as teacher as the good policy.

units.zh: 如近來時務、知新等報所論，尊俠力，伸民權，興黨會，改制度，甚則欲去拜跪之禮儀，廢滿、漢之文字，平君臣之尊卑，改男女之外內。
units.en: As recent papers such as Current Affairs and New Knowledge discuss: honor chivalry, extend people's rights, establish societies, change institutions—even to abolishing kneeling and prostration, abolishing Manchu and Han scripts, leveling the honor between ruler and minister, and changing the separation of men and women inside and out.
units.literal: As recent papers such as Current Affairs and New Knowledge discuss: honor chivalry, extend people's rights, establish societies, change institutions—even to abolishing kneeling and prostration, abolishing Manchu and Han scripts, leveling the honor between ruler and minister, and changing the separation of men and women inside and out.

units.zh: 直似只須中國一變而為外洋政教風俗，即可立致富強，而不知其勢小則群起鬥爭，立可召亂；
units.en: It is as if China need only change at once into foreign government, teaching, and custom to become rich and strong at once, without knowing that on a small scale factions will rise and fight and disorder may be summoned at once;
units.literal: It is as if China need only change at once into foreign government, teaching, and custom to become rich and strong at once, without knowing that on a small scale factions will rise and fight and disorder may be summoned at once;

units.zh: 大則各便私利，賣國何難？
units.en: on a large scale each will seek private advantage—how hard would it be to sell the state?
units.literal: on a large scale each will seek private advantage—how hard to sell the state?

units.zh: 曾以此言戒勸康有為，乃不思省改，且更私聚數百人，在輦轂之下，立為保國會，日執途人而號之曰：'中國必亡，必亡！
units.en: I once admonished Kang Youwei with these words, yet he would not reflect and reform; instead he privately gathered several hundred men under the capital, established a Society to Protect the State, and daily seized passersby crying: 'China must perish, must perish!'
units.literal: I once admonished Kang Youwei with these words, yet he would not reflect and reform; instead he privately gathered several hundred men under the capital, established a Society to Protect the State, and daily seized passersby crying: 'China must perish, must perish!'

units.zh: '以致士夫惶駭，庶眾搖惑。
units.en: So that scholars were alarmed and the common people shaken.
units.literal: so that scholars were alarmed and the common people shaken.

units.zh: 設使四民解體，大盜生心，藉此以集聚匪徒，招誘黨羽，因而犯上作亂，未知康有為又何以善其後？
units.en: Suppose the four classes dissolve and great robbers take heart; using this to gather bandits and entice partisans, and thereby rebel against superiors—who knows how Kang Youwei would then set things right?
units.literal: Suppose the four classes dissolve and great robbers take heart; using this to gather bandits and entice partisans, and thereby rebel against superiors—who knows how Kang Youwei would then set things right?

units.zh: 曾令其將忠君愛國合為一事，勿徒欲保中國而置我大清於度外，康有為亦似悔之。
units.en: I once told him to join loyalty to the ruler and love of country in one matter and not merely wish to preserve China while setting our Great Qing outside consideration; Kang Youwei also seemed to repent.
units.literal: I once told him to join loyalty to the ruler and love of country in one matter and not merely wish to preserve China while setting our Great Qing outside consideration; Kang Youwei also seemed to repent.

units.zh: 又曾手書御史名單一紙，欲臣倡首鼓動眾人伏闕痛哭，力請變法。
units.en: He also once wrote out a list of censors by hand, wishing that I lead in stirring the multitude to kneel weeping at the palace gate and urgently plead for reform.
units.literal: He also once wrote out a list of censors by hand, wishing that I lead in stirring the multitude to kneel weeping at the palace gate and urgently plead for reform.

units.zh: 當告以言官結黨為國朝大禁，此事萬不可為。
units.en: I told him that censors forming factions is a great prohibition of our dynasty and this matter must on no account be done.
units.literal: I told him that censors forming factions is a great prohibition of our dynasty and this matter must on no account be done.

units.zh: 以康有為一人在京城任意妄為，遍結言官，把持國事，已足駭人聽聞；
units.en: That Kang Youwei alone in the capital acted wantonly, bound censors everywhere, and controlled state affairs is already enough to shock the ear;
units.literal: That Kang Youwei alone in the capital acted wantonly, bound censors everywhere, and controlled state affairs is already enough to shock the ear;

units.zh: 而宋伯魯、楊深秀身為臺諫，公然聯名庇黨，誣參朝廷大臣，此風何可長也！
units.en: and Song Bolu and Yang Shenxiu, themselves remonstrating officials, openly joined names to shield a faction and falsely impeached court ministers—how may this wind be allowed to grow!
units.literal: and Song Bolu and Yang Shenxiu, themselves remonstrating officials, openly joined names to shield a faction and falsely impeached court ministers—how may this wind be allowed to grow!

units.zh: 伏思國家變法，原為整頓國事，非欲敗壞國事。
units.en: I reflect that the state's reform was originally to put state affairs in order, not to ruin state affairs.
units.literal: I reflect that the state's reform was originally to put state affairs in order, not to ruin state affairs.

units.zh: 譬如屋宇年久失修，自應招工依法改造，若任三五喜事之徒曳之傾倒，而曰非此不能從速，恐梁棟毀折，且將傷人。
units.en: It is like a house long out of repair: one should hire workers to remodel it according to law; if one lets three or five men fond of novelty drag it down and say nothing else can be quick, I fear beams and rafters will break and people will be hurt.
units.literal: It is like a house long out of repair: one should hire workers to remodel it according to law; if one lets three or five men fond of novelty drag it down and say nothing else can be quick, I fear beams and rafters will break and people will be hurt.

units.zh: 康有為之變法，何以異是？
units.en: How is Kang Youwei's reform different from this?
units.literal: How is Kang Youwei's reform different from this?

units.zh: 此所以不敢已於言也。」
units.en: This is why I dare not cease speaking."
units.literal: This is why I dare not cease speaking."

units.zh: 光緒二十四年，變法詔下，禮部主事王照應詔上言，尚書許應騤不為代奏。
units.en: In 1898, when the reform edict was issued, Wang Zhao of the Ministry of Rites responded to the edict with a memorial, but Minister Xu Yingkui did not transmit it.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu, when the reform edict was issued, Wang Zhao of the Ministry of Rites responded to the edict with a memorial, but Minister Xu Yingkui did not transmit it.

units.zh: 疏上，斥回原衙門行走。
units.en: When the memorial was submitted, he was dismissed to serve in his original yamen.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted, he was dismissed to serve in his original yamen.

units.zh: 太后復訓政，賞文悌知府，旋授河南知府。
units.en: When the empress dowager resumed regency, Wen Ti was rewarded with the post of prefect and soon appointed prefect of Henan.
units.literal: When the empress dowager resumed regency, Wen Ti was rewarded with the post of prefect and soon appointed prefect of Henan.

units.zh: 二十六年，兩宮西狩，文悌迎駕，擢貴西道。
units.en: In 1900, when the two palaces fled west, Wen Ti welcomed the imperial progress and was promoted to Guixi Circuit.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, when the two palaces went west on campaign, Wen Ti welcomed the imperial progress and was promoted to Guixi Circuit.

units.zh: 乞病歸，卒。
units.en: He begged leave on illness and died.
units.literal: He begged leave on illness and died.

units.zh: 文悌言攻結黨，實啟黨爭，而春霖連劾權貴，言尤痛切，當國者終於不悟。
units.en: Wen Ti attacked factionalism in words but in fact opened party struggle; Chunlin repeatedly impeached the powerful, his words especially cutting—yet those who held the state never understood in the end.
units.literal: Wen Ti attacked factionalism in words but in fact opened party struggle; Chunlin repeatedly impeached the powerful, his words especially cutting—yet those who held the state never understood in the end.

units.zh: 劉光第，字裴村，四川富順人。
units.en: Liu Guangdi, whose courtesy name was Peicun, came from Fushun in Sichuan.
units.literal: Liu Guangdi, courtesy name Peicun, was a native of Fushun in Sichuan.

units.zh: 楊銳呼曰：「裴村，跪！
units.en: Yang Rui called out, "Peicun, kneel!
units.literal: Yang Rui called out: "Peicun, kneel!

units.zh: 未一月而禍作，光第自投獄。
units.en: Less than a month later the disaster broke out, and Guangdi surrendered himself to prison.
units.literal: Less than a month later disaster broke out, and Guangdi surrendered himself to prison.

units.zh: 光緒九年進士，授刑部主事。
units.en: In Guangxu 9 he took his jinshi degree and was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Punishments.
units.literal: In Guangxu year nine he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed ministry secretary in the Ministry of Punishments.

units.zh: 又以陳寶箴薦，與劉光第、譚嗣同、林旭並加四品卿，充軍機章京，參新政。
units.en: Again through Chen Baozhen’s recommendation, he, together with Liu Guangdi, Tan Sitong, and Lin Xu, was given fourth-rank ministerial title, appointed a Grand Council secretary, and took part in the new policies.
units.literal: Again through Chen Baozhen’s recommendation, he, together with Liu Guangdi, Tan Sitong, and Lin Xu, was given fourth-rank ministerial title, appointed a Grand Council secretary, and took part in the new policies.

units.zh: 通周官、禮及大小戴禮記。
units.en: He was deeply versed in the Offices of Zhou, the Rites, and both recensions of the Record of Rites.
units.literal: He was versed in the Offices of Zhou, the Rites, and the Record of Rites of the Elder and Younger Dai.

units.zh: 著有介白堂詩文集。
units.en: He wrote Jiebaitang shiwenji.
units.literal: His writings include Jiebaitang shiwenji.

units.zh: 其應召也，亦以陳寶箴薦，然非其素志，將具疏辭，川人官京朝者力勸之。
units.en: He answered the summons on Chen Baozhen's recommendation too, though it was not what he had wanted; he was preparing a memorial to decline when Sichuan colleagues in the capital pressed him hard to accept.
units.literal: When he answered the summons, it was also on Chen Baozhen's recommendation; yet this was not his original intent, and he was about to prepare a memorial declining, but Sichuan officials serving in the capital strongly urged him on.

units.zh: 獨與楊銳善。
units.en: Yang Rui alone numbered among his close friends.
units.literal: He was on good terms with Yang Rui alone.

units.zh: 家素貧，而性廉介，非舊交，雖禮饋弗受。
units.en: His family had always been poor, but he was incorruptible by nature and would accept no courtesy gift from anyone who was not an old friend.
units.literal: His family had long been poor, yet his nature was upright and incorruptible; unless they were old friends, he would not accept gifts even of courtesy.

units.zh: 一日，召見，力陳時危民困，外患日迫，亟宜虛懷圖治，上稱善。
units.en: One day he was received in audience and spoke urgently of national peril, popular distress, and the daily tightening of foreign pressure, urging the emperor to govern with an open mind; the emperor was pleased.
units.literal: One day he was summoned for audience and forcefully stated that the times were perilous, the people distressed, and foreign danger pressing daily; the throne should urgently open its mind and plan good government—the emperor approved.

units.zh: 退語所親曰：「吾終不任此，行當亟假歸矣！」
units.en: Afterward he told those close to him, “I cannot bear this responsibility to the end; I mean to ask leave and go home at once!”
units.literal: Afterward he told those close to him, “I cannot bear this responsibility to the end; I mean to ask leave and go home at once!”

units.zh: 臨刑，協辦大學士剛毅監斬，光第詫曰：「未訊而誅，何哉？」
units.en: At the execution, Associate Grand Secretary Gangyi supervised the beheading, and Guangdi cried out in astonishment, "To execute a man without trial--why?"
units.literal: At the execution, Associate Grand Secretary Gangyi supervised the beheading, and Guangdi cried out in astonishment: "To execute a man without trial--why?"

units.zh: 令跪聽旨，光第不可，曰：「祖制，雖盜賊，臨刑呼冤，當復訊。
units.en: He was ordered to kneel and hear the edict; Guangdi refused, saying, "By ancestral law, even a thief who cries injustice at execution must be interrogated again.
units.literal: He was ordered to kneel and hear the edict, but Guangdi refused, saying: "By ancestral law, even a thief who cries injustice at execution must be interrogated again.

units.zh: 吾輩縱不足惜，如國體何！」
units.en: Even if we are not worth sparing, what of the dignity of the state!”
units.literal: Even if we are not worth sparing, what of the dignity of the state!”

units.zh: 乃跪就戮。
units.en: Then he knelt and went to his death.
units.literal: Then he knelt and submitted to execution.
